Closed combat - Millie is highly adept at close combat in terms of raw strength, she is able to dismember armed human and eldritch opponents in hand-to-hand combat, being strong enough to force the jaws of a building sized monster open, or crush a human's skull with her thighs. Her actual close combat tactical skills are questionable, as she has been defeated by skilled or advantageously positioned opponents in melee combat on several occasions.

Volleyball-playing - Millie has proficient skills in volleyball, allowing her to make a perfect strike despite fracturing a camper's skull.

Driving - Millie has a driver skills that is essential for her work, and can even drive aggressively when she crashed into the wedding between Moxxie and Chazwick Thurman.
Intelligence - In "Unhappy Campers", she was able to deduct that Counselor Jimmy was the culprit behind the murder of a client due to his shifty appearance and possession of money, drugs, and a drill. In "Mission: Antarctica", when she examined the marks on the seal's corpse, she identified them as non-bullet-inflicted scratches and bite marks, deducing that the seal wasn't running at her, Blitzo, and Moxxie, but was running away from whatever attacked it. She also possessed some knowledge regarding Blitzo's Asmodean Crystal, saying that because its from Lust it shouldn't be forced but "treated right" and caressed to work. In "Ghostf**kers," Blitzo commends Millie for her intellect in a flashback and she was able to figure out who the culprit was in the One Star Wonder hotel murders.

Trivia

As shown in "The Harvest Moon Festival", she has knives on the side of her and Moxxie's shared bed.
In Vivziepop's 2019 short Holidaze as an ornament on a Christmas Tree, there is a tree carved with initials "M+M →B←" in a heart that alludes to her, Moxxie, and Blitzo.[8]
While Millie seems to tolerate Blitzo's intrusions, she is not shown to be comfortable with other men flirting with her, as the game attendant pushing Moxxie away and attempting to flirt with her noticeably upsets her.
However in "The Harvest Moon Festival", she didn't seem to mind and was actually flattered by Striker's attempt to flirt with her.
In "The Harvest Moon Festival", it is revealed that she is no longer allowed to participate in the Pain Games because she was responsible for nine out of the fifteen funerals that occurred at the time.
It was revealed in "The Harvest Moon Festival" that one of her brothers got married at one point, and that she got severely injured while competing over who would catch the bouquet, but in the end Millie managed to do so.
In "Truth Seekers", she claims she is about five years older than Loona. If this is true, this places her and possibly Moxxie's age somewhere in her mid or late 20s, as Loona isn't any younger than eighteen.
It was stated in a livestream on April 30, 2022, that in hell years Loona is 22, making Millie roughly 27 years old. It has not been confirmed, however, if Hell years are similar to Earth years, which makes their Earth age unknown.[note 1]
It is revealed in "Ozzie's" that she and Moxxie have been married for a year. With the premiere date of the episode being approximately a year apart from the series' first episode, "Murder Family".
In "Exes and Oohs" it was revealed on Moxxie's Sinstagram that Millie took his last name after they got married.
It is revealed through Blitzo's text history with her in "Seeing Stars" that Millie sends Blitzo pictures of the sex toys she plans on using on Moxxie, asking Blitzo on what he thinks of them.
Millie is rarely seen without her choker, even in bed.
According to Vivziepop, Millie is planned to have more with her as the biggest/sole focus later on, and that she gets her episodes in the second season.[9]
Vivziepop confirmed that in an upcoming episode Millie will sing "a more goofy song".[10] This could be referring to the song "Regular Joe", which is also her first solo song.
Millie shares some characteristics of Kayla from ZooPhobia. Both are outgoing, romantic and music loving girls. Millie and Kayla have a hard time holding their anger and are willing to get violent and aggressive to hurt their enemies, but also to protect the people they love, especially their boyfriends. Millie and Kayla are combative, capable of mastering melee weapons.
Millie's nickname could be a pun on how she is more adept at using melee weapons.
According to Morgana Ignis, Millie is straight.[11]
It is revealed in "Ghostf**kers" that Millie moved to the Pride Ring after joining I.M.P, and before meeting Blitzo, she used to be a free-lance assassin, who at one time stole a job from Moxxie, which led to Blitzo wanting to hire her.
As of "Sinsmas", Millie is revealed to be pregnant with Moxxie’s child.
Development

Vivziepop had stated that she would change Millie's voice actor once the actual series premieres but would still keep her previous voice actor, Erica Lindbeck, to voice Loona.[12] Later, actress and dancer Vivian Nixon was hired to voice Millie, who developed her voice to have a Southern accent.
In a tweet, Vivziepop explains that Millie's personality traits are written to be on display but they tend to be upbeat, and that her not coming from pain and trauma, like Blitzo, Moxxie, and Loona do, does not take away from her character.[13]
Vivziepop goes on to say that Millie has some fun things coming, but she won't have a tragic/dramatic story like the others.[14]
She also explained that while being "Moxxie's wife" is a big part of her in the show,[15] Moxxie is also motivated by his relationship, but as Vivziepop found more storylines with him that influenced Blitzo and the overall narrative with Blitzo, he got to develop more first.[16] However, Millie does already have a lot going on about her[17] and we will reach Millie's episodes.[16]

"♪ I am the mastermind, and here I am the law. I've ruled the endless dark since long before the golden angel's fall. So you see, next to me, your master plans all look so small. Little mice, when you break my rules, you pay the price! ♪"
―Satan, to Stolas in "Mastermind"
Satan is a major character in Helluva Boss who made his official debut in the episode "Mastermind". He is one of the Seven Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Wrath.[1][2]

Due to Lucifer Morningstar's absence, Satan became the stand-in leader of the Sins and ruler of affairs in Hell.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Satan is a titanic and muscular draconic demon. He has two pairs of warm orange-yellow eyes, and two pairs of striped-horns that are different in appearance - the outer horns are longer and are two shades of mauve, while the inner horns are shorter and are black-and-white, similar to that of a male imp, and they are positioned in a way that resembles a pitchfork.

His skin appears to be different shades of red with claw-like fingers, darker-red markings, and warm orange-yellow lava-like stripes covering his wings, neck, and left arm, while on his right the stripes are dark red. He also sports black spikes coming out his back, all the way down to his large, demonic tail, which has a spearhead-shaped point at the end.

Satan is dressed in a way that is reminiscent of traditional American western-style clothing, as a nod of his association with imps of the Wrath Ring. His outfit consists of a mauve tank top under a black torn vest with tassels, red lapels, and golden fasteners shaped like barbell weights, black leather trousers with a belt that has a golden skull buckle, and black cowboy ankle boots.
Personality

Matching the sin he represents, Satan is shown to be a very wrathful demon with anger issues and he chronically has outbursts which leave him out of control. His uncontrollable rage is too much to the point that he needs a therapist to act like a "shoulder angel" to remind him to keep calm. Despite this, he can also be reasoned and well-sophisticated most of the time, unless he is provoked.

He is shown as having little to no care towards the demons that are below the nobility in the hierarchy of Hell, especially imps, whom he claims to have created for the purpose of obeying orders and doing their jobs. Despite holding royal demons in a much greater regard, he didn't hesitate to strip Stolas of his power and title and give it to Andrealphus as punishment for breaking demon law. He also quickly dismissed Asmodeus and Beelzebub's request to give Blitzo a fair trial, using the opinion of the rest of the court to justify it.

Satan is also shown as being immensely vain and arrogant, reveling on his position as leader of the Deadly Sins in Lucifer's absence. Despite the fact that Lucifer is the first ruler of Hell, Satan lies and proclaims himself as being the original ruler of Hell, though it is shown that Beelzebub and Asmodeus are aware of his lie.

Despite this, however, Satan is implied to have a slightly friendlier demeanor when off-the-clock, which is suggested with Beezlebub's comments and how she saw him as a brother figure. Furthermore, he is willing to let others go if they plead not guilty, such as when Blitzo convinced him not to execute the rest of I.M.P and just him, and again when he released Blitzo after Stolas admitted to being responsible for his crimes.

He doesn’t seem too fond of spending a long period of time in court, particularly when it is nearly lunch time. Because of this, Satan would prefer having the defendant executed rather than listen to their testimony if it means speeding it up.
Abilities

Immortality - As he is called "your majesty" in "Mastermind", it can be assumed that Satan is demonic royalty and biologically immortal, being able to live for a long period of time and only able to be killed by angelic weaponry.
Size alteration - While Satan's "normal" size alone towers over most demons, even his fellow Sins, he shows that he can easily alter his size at will, making himself even larger to an unspecified degree.
Flight - Satan is able to fly thanks to his giant draconic wings.
Environment manipulation - Satan can warp the colors, ambience, and illumination of every room and palace where he is, as shown when Satan interrupts Stolas' musical number and the courtroom turns into an orange-yellow color.
Pyrokinesis - As shown in his song, Satan is able to create images out of flame, like the image of a six-winged angel. The smoke that emits from his nostrils when he is angry may suggest he can also breathe fire.
Satan stripping Stolas' powers
Satan stripping Stolas' powers
Power deactivation - Satan, with the use of an enchanted set of rings bearing the sigils of the Seven Deadly Sins, can strip high-ranking demons like Goetic aristocrats of their powers and status. He performed this on Stolas and set it for a hundred years for providing the grimoire to Blitzo and allegedly commanding him to use it illegally.
Enhanced strength - Befitting his size, Satan seemingly possesses incredible physical strength, such as being able to crack the floor when he steps off his throne. He also displayed his strength when he shakes the ground by slamming onto it during the trial.
Skillset

Leadership - As the stand-in leader of the Seven Deadly Sins and the rest of Hell due to Lucifer's absence, Satan has a strong sense of strictness and command within its government, with the other Sins deferring to him as their adjudicator without questioning his ability. He is also incredibly intimidating compared to the other Sins, to the point even high-ranking Hellborn species are terrified of displeasing him by stepping out of line.
Musical talent - Satan is shown to be a decent singer, as seen in his song.
History

Past

Not much is known about Satan's history other than at some point he joined Lucifer as part of the Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Wrath. Satan was also the alleged creator of the imp race.

At some point, Satan assumed leadership of the Seven Deadly Sins and became the de facto ruler of Hell during Lucifer's absence.

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Mastermind"

Satan leads the trial in which Blitzo is accused of breaking Hell's law by travelling to Earth for his job. As the trial goes on, Satan listens to Andrealphus and Striker's testimonies and decides to sentence Blitzo and his crew to death, rejecting a fair trial despite Asmodeus and Beelzebub's requests in favor of a quick execution, simply because he would rather have lunch than go through the full process of court. However, Blitzo convinces Satan to spare his crew and execute him alone instead.

Just as Blitzo is about to be executed, the trial is interrupted by Stolas, who takes the blame for Blitzo's case, claiming himself to be the "mastermind", which appears to anger Satan. Satan has Blitzo to be released as Stolas faces the consequences for his crimes. When Stolas placed his head on the execution stand as he thought that he would be executed, Satan explained that he won't have Stolas executed due to being a Goetic prince. With Andrealphus' suggestion for a fitting punishment, Satan ultimately decides to sentence Stolas to banishment, stripping him of his powers and status for the next 100 years.

Gallery

Satan/Gallery
Trivia

Satan is based on the Biblical character of Satan, an archetypical rendition of the Devil that embodies all sin, malice, and temptation plaguing humanity.
The Devil is a figure integral in the Abrahamic religions, although as an entity, its portrayal varies greatly. In the Bible, the Devil is often addressed as "Satan", a word derived from the Hebrew word שָּׂטָן, meaning "adversary". However, some writings depict Satan, and in extension, the Devil, as an individual with multiple words and names; words such as "Azazel", "Beelzebub", "Belial", "Lucifer", "Samael", "Samyaza", and others, are sometimes synonymous with the word "Satan". Conversely, in a great number of texts, these words are attributed to separate entities. In the Hazbin Hotel and Helluva Boss universe, this is shown to be the case, as Azazel, Beelzebub, Lucifer, and Satan, are all separate characters.[3][1]
Furthermore, Satan, Lucifer, and Beelzebub individually represent the sins of Wrath, Pride, and Gluttony, respectively.[1]
In the Hellaverse, the sins' demon classification is heavily inspired by Peter Binsfeld's classification of demons, based on an anonymous text from the 15th century known as The Lanterne of Light. In both The Lanterne of Light and Binsfeld's classification, Satan is one of the seven demons associated with the seven deadly sins, embodying the deadly sin of Wrath. Likewise, Satan in Helluva Boss is the embodiment of Wrath.
The symbol that appears on the back of Satan's throne and the rings of the Seven Deadly Sins, a pentagram, is a symbol often associated with Satan, and is heavily featured within LaVeyan Satanism.
Satan's dragon-themed design could possibly be a nod to Satan's appearance in The Book of Revelation from The Bible, in which Satan is said to manifest in the form of a red dragon with seven heads and ten horns.
In a livestream, Vivienne Medrano first stated in Helluva Boss that Satan is the "sin of Wrath" whom imps view as a deity-like figure, hence why many characters have cursed by Satan's name in a few episodes.[1] Other demons aside from imps have also been shown cursing by Satan's name as well.
In the pilot episode of Helluva Boss a homeless imp can be seen holding a sign that says "Satan Bless".
As shown in the episode "Ozzie's" on Blitzo's phone, Satan has an app named after himself called "Satan's Workouts".
According to Vivziepop, Leviathan and Satan were planned to be the most traditional in sticking with the usual themes in terms of design, but as of June 26, 2023, she was still working on finalizing them.[2]
St. An's Hospital's name, "St. An's", is a play on words of "Satan".
In the song Mastermind, Satan claims that he originally reigned over Hell, or the "endless darkness", prior to Lucifer's exile from Heaven. However, in a tweet Vivziepop revealed that because of Lucifer's absence, Satan can say anything he wants. She also confirmed that Lucifer has always been the first ruler of Hell, and Asmodeus and Beelzebub know Satan lied,[4] acknowledging this with a look at Lucifer's vacant throne and rolling their eyes in response to Satan's proclamation.
Due to Lucifer's absence, Satan appears to currently be the stand-in ruler in charge of Hell's affairs. This, in turn, makes him the de facto leader among the currently active Seven Deadly Sins.
Although Satan states he created the imp species, it is unknown if he has the actual power to do so or if he had assistance when he made them.
The conflict of Satan against Blitzo and Stolas is first foreshadowed in Emberlynn Pinkle's fanfiction featuring her self-insert OC shipped with Blitzo, as shown in the Helluva Short "Mission: Weeaboo-boo".

Andrealphus is a supporting antagonist of Helluva Boss who made his debut in the episode "Western Energy". He is a Marquis of the Ars Goetia, the brother of Stella, and, by extension, the brother-in-law of Stolas and the uncle of Octavia.[2]

Andrealphus is also the one who convinced Stella to call off the assailant she hired for the time being, as having Stolas alive would benefit the siblings far more than having him dead.

As of "Mastermind", Andrealphus was left with Stolas' responsibilities for the next hundred years after Stolas was banished from the Ars Goetia.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Andrealphus is a lanky, peacock-like avian demon with a short light blue beak, and cyan eyes that both lack pupils and irises and have periwinkle upper-eyelids. His feathers appear to be mostly white with slicked-back, short, light periwinkle hair with a few dark blue spots. Inside his beak, his tongue is a cyan color.

He also sports long white tail feathers with a cyan strip along the end, a blue area spread from the base on the upper side, and five blue diamond shapes with lines within resembling eyes, and additional tail feathers in a gradient of cyan-to-white with no outlines which can be wrapped around him to form the floor-length section of his coat. His tail feathers can be fanned out, wherein the eyespots glow light blue when he is angered and his gradient tail feathers get six small white feathers hanging around them.

Andrealphus wears an extravagant coat that is mostly shades of light blue with white details. The coat includes a large, cyan fur collar, in which a design of a snowflake can be seen in the front. He also tends to keep his arms hidden away in the fur of his coat.

Under his coat, he wears a navy long-sleeved shirt with a white-trimmed high collar and four white buttons, white pants, and navy over-the-knee heeled boots. He accessorizes with a cyan snowflake-like crown, and a pair of white opera gloves.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Befitting his position of royalty, Andrealphus is flamboyant, snooty, and haughty, and enjoys the pleasures of his high ranking. Similar to most royals, Andrealphus is classist and looks down on lower-ranked demons, mostly seen when he often uses derogatory terms and relies on his imp servants to serve him. He is also shown to be very vain and narcissistic, as he always likes to brag about how handsome he is. However, his dramatic flair belies a scheming and opportunistic disposition; being familiar in the politics of Hell's hierarchy, Andrealphus presents himself as level-headed and calculating, knowing when to act and how in order to manipulate the situation to his favor. As such, he can be quite cold-hearted and remorseless, eager to trump on others for his own benefits.

Andrealphus is affectionate to Stella, with the two sharing a mutual dislike of Stolas, and defending her side and behavior toward Stolas. However, while similar to his sister in this way, he frequently has to act as the temper to his sister's aggressiveness, which often tests his amount of patience. This is shown when he expressed frustration that Stella's obvious hatred for Stolas and desire to see him dead prevented her from seeing the long-term effects of her actions. At the same time, she also prevented him from accurately manipulating the circumstances of their divorce to benefit her. Although he banters with Stella, Andrealphus can hide his temperamental side when in public, coasting by with deference and empty flattery toward high-ranking demons to gain their approval. Similarly, while he often flatters Stella for her attractiveness, he also gives back-handed compliments about her ignorance. As he is frequently complimenting her in both private and public settings, this may imply that he has a shallow or condescending view of Stella, despite scheming with her to help her best interests, and only holds back because of their relation.

Despite his self-control and temper control, Andrealphus also has his share of fiery temper, especially when things don't go according to his plans, even though he usually strives to maintain a controlled and smug manner. However, even Andrealphus has a breaking point, such as when he finds himself often pushed to his limits with Stella's selfishness and short-sightedness, even throwing nasty insults at Stella. Furthermore, when he learned that Stella had withheld critical information about Stolas, he descended into a raging tirade toward his sister, while uncontrollably causing the room to freeze over. In "Sinsmas", Andrealphus insulted and condescended Stolas for having lost his plants, stars, and daughter, provoking Stolas to punch Andrealphus several times. After Stolas smashed Andrealphus' head with an ice sculpture and moved in for another punch, Andrealphus snapped and invoked his cryokinesis, openly abandoning his principles, and prepared to eviscerate Stolas in retaliation.

Like Stella, Andrealphus is also known not to think things through. In "Sinsmas", after Octavia knocked Andrealphus down to protect Stolas from him, Andrealphus threatened to tell Stella what Octavia did, only for both Blitzo and Octavia to point out that Stella would be more upset over Andrealphus losing to a lower class species which would be considered a "very bad look" for him.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Andrealphus using Cyrokinesis
Andrealphus's Cryokinesis
Cryokinesis - Andrealphus has demonstrated the ability to conjure and manipulate ice. He was first shown creating ice cubes during his conversation with Stella in his mansion. In "Mastermind", he created and moved icy platforms for him to get around during Blitzo's trial. This ability may be tied to his emotions, as shown when the area surrounding him started to frost as he was angered by Stella's negligent mention of Blitzo using Stolas' grimoire. Furthermore, he spat out his tea in shock at his Imp servant and froze him, implying that anything warm he consumes becomes cold and is capable of freezing anything it lands onto.
Ice construct creation – In "Sinsmas", Andrealphus can turn the feathers on his tail into icy malleable pillars he can direct, extend, and reshape, granting him a large range to cover and freeze whatever they hit. He can also split these pillars into separate entities as well, such as the ice he encased Stolas in, reforming itself into a large dragon, then hydra, out of pure ice and snow, with Andrealphus commanding it like a puppet to battle against I.M.P.
Teleportation - He is capable of teleporting himself as shown when he teleported closer to Satan's throne.
Telekinesis - He was able to block Stolas' punch using telekinesis.
Levitation - He is capable of levitating in the air.
Skillset

Wide intellect - Andrealphus is shown to be a level-headed and calculating person, such as when he convinced Stella to keep Stolas alive so that they could profit more from him. He also arranged for I.M.P, and especially Blitzo, to be sentenced with the use of falsified testimonies from himself and Striker to win the favor of the other demonic royalty.
ADVERTISEMENT
Trivia

Andrealphus is based on the demon from the Ars Goetia of the same name, who is a marquis of Hell and depicted as a peacock.
Andrealphus first appeared in a trailer for content to be released in 2022 on Vivziepop's YouTube channel, prior to when she teased his design on her Twitter before his official debut in the series, referring to him as "Stolas' shitty brother-in-law".[2]
He is the first character to get official merchandise before his actual appearance in the Helluva Boss series - in his case, an enamel pin

Agent One is a supporting antagonist from Helluva Boss who made his debut alongside his partner, Agent Two, in the episode "Truth Seekers".

He and Agent Two both work for D.H.O.R.K.S., with him sporting a subtle New York accent.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Agent One is a pale-skinned man with short brown hair, and with his eyes almost always being covered by a pair of black shades.

He is dressed in a uniform consisting of a black-ish dark red tuxedo-jacket with red lapels, which he accessorizes with a "D" pin on the left side. He wears his jacket over a white-collared shirt with a black necktie. Along with this, Agent One also wore both black pants and dress shoes.
Personality

As a member of D.H.O.R.K.S., it is presumed that Agent One is well-versed in the study of paranormal activity and completely believes in the existence of demons.

However, he and his partner seem to lack giving proper attention to detail and do not seem intelligent enough to realize what Blitzo and Moxxie were despite their belief in demons (even if they were indeed correct about the species), since they were quick to lose their belief once Moxxie pointed this out.

While he is seen as a professional, it is known that he tends to break his tough facade when his deceased mother is mentioned. He appears to be the more emotional between himself and Agent Two.

Agents One and Two are not above sending children into possibly dangerous situations, shown when sending them to Hell in "The Full Moon", however, Agent One did get a tear in his eye and salute them as American heroes. They also didn't care to have their deceased colleagues' corpses cleaned up after the events of "Truth Seekers".

Agent One may also be a furry, as he appeared to have eagerly wore the Loona fursuit in "The Full Moon".
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Skillset

Athleticism - Agent One is able to rapidly reposition himself during a combat situation without exhausting himself, and still being combat effective.
Intelligence gathering - Agent One shows proficiency in the collection and assessment of reported sightings of demonic activity (in regards to I.M.P) across their country.
Interrogation - Agent One possesses limited effectiveness in interrogating a subject. Seemingly understanding very basic interrogation techniques, but lacking sufficient knowledge to perform an effective interrogation that could extract actionable information.
Combat knowledge - Agent One demonstrates effective urban tactical knowledge, such as being able to rapidly set up and spring an ambush against multiple demonic targets with little preparation time.
Weapon proficiency - Agent One is proficient in the usage of several weapons, including handguns and net-guns.

She is dressed in a uniform consisting of a black-ish dark red tuxedo-jacket with red lapels, which she accessorizes with a "D" pin on the right side. She wears her jacket over a white-collared shirt with a black necktie. Along with this, Agent Two also wears both black dress pants and low-heeled shoes.
Personality

As a member of D.H.O.R.K.S., it is presumed that Agent Two is well-versed in the study of paranormal activity and completely believes in the existence of demons.

However, she and her partner seem to lack giving proper attention to detail and do not seem intelligent enough to realize what Blitzo and Moxxie were despite their belief in demons (even if they were indeed correct about the species), since they were quick to lose their belief once Moxxie pointed this out.

Two is shown to be the slightly smarter member that leads Agent One, and appears to be knowledgeable about Japanese history, being particularly fond of the Edo period.

Agents Two and One are not above sending children into possibly dangerous situations, shown when sending them to Hell in "The Full Moon", and didn't care to have their deceased colleagues' corpses cleaned up after the events of "Truth Seekers".

The All-Imp Circus is the now-disbanded and destroyed unnamed circus that was led by Imp ringleader Cash Buckzo.

The circus made its debut in "The Circus" and was destroyed in a flashback shown in "Oops", shortly followed by it being disbanded.

There are numerous circus tents, colored in red and white with flags at the tops, and also triangular bunting strung from the tops in red, blue and white. There is also a Ferris wheel.

Several carriages, crates and barrels can also be found around the circus grounds.
History

As shown in "The Circus", Stolas was brought to the circus by his father, Paimon, in order to stop Stolas from crying over his engagement. At the circus Blitzo and Fizzarolli performed together and got the attention of Stolas, who was immediately smitten by Blitzo. Afterward, Paimon negotiated with Blitzo's father and the circus' ringleader, Cash Buckzo, to buy Blitzo to be Stolas' friend.

On Fizzarolli's birthday fifteen years prior to "Oops", Blitzo intended to give Fizzarolli a flower and letter sealed with a heart. Ashamed and jealous, Blitzo stormed off after seeing the admiration his father gave Fizzarolli and shoved into someone who dropped a cake that set fire to the circus and burned it down. Barbie Wire is a minor antagonist who is first pictured in the Helluva Boss pilot, and makes her official debut in "Unhappy Campers".

She is a former circus performer and Blitzo's twin sister, the adoptive aunt of Loona, as well as the former co-worker of Fizzarolli.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:01

41:20

Current

Being Blitzo's twin sister, Barbie is a rather tall, slim and red-skinned imp who sports a long demonic tail. She has a long narrow head, with a pair of large curly horns colored black with thin white stripes, a heart-shaped skull symbol on the center of her forehead, and a mouth full of sharp yellow teeth inside. Her eyes have red irises, yellow sclera, and slit-like pupils.

Her tail has white markings, her head-marking is crossed out with a white 'X' and has a small heart on the top and bottom, and she has thin white striped-markings down her arms. She also has black fingers.

Barbie is seen dressed in a sleeveless, maroon-and-white-striped turtleneck minidress with a few ripped areas and a darker red stripe from the chest to the neck, along with thigh-high black boots. In "Unhappy Campers", she also wore a dark gray sleeveless jacket with torn edges over her dress, and a gold-and-brown wristwatch that contains an Asmodean Crystal inside, allowing her to shift into a human disguise.

Under her dress, Barbie is also seen wearing a black thong underneath.

Young

As a child, she lacked the white markings on her arms and forehead she has as an adult. She also lacked the black coloring on the tips of her fingers.

As a teenager, she wore braces just like her brother, Blitzo.

Human Disguise

With the power of the Asmodean Crystal, Barbie takes the form of a light brown-skinned human woman with dark brown hair kept into pigtails. While she retains her white markings and clothing, her eyes' irises change to pale red and her sclera to white.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Barbie is an egotistical, narcissistic, and manipulative woman who has a bad temper and is rude, even to her own drug supplier. Very much like her brother, she has very arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding traits, and easily grows upset when things don't go her way.

She is also cunning and has a low opinion of humans, considering them to be easy to manipulate, as she can easily use her seductive feminine charms to woo her victims into doing her bidding.

In "Unhappy Campers", she is shown to have a hatred for Blitzo, and says she wants nothing to do with him. The reason for why she hates her brother is currently unknown. Although, it's possible that she hates Blitzo for what he has done to their family's Circus, even if it was accidental.

She seems to have some standards when it comes to forms of "illegal activity". She is fine with selling drugs, but was openly disapproving at the fact that her supplier, Counselor Jimmy, killed another camp counselor and refused to hear any excuses, especially when it could possibly threaten her drug-selling job. For example, when Jimmy said that the other counselor found out about her drugs, and it could risk reaching the law enforcements about it.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Human disguise - In "Unhappy Campers" she uses a special wristwatch containing an Asmodean Crystal to take on a convincing human appearance to disguise herself in the living world.
Prehensile tail - She is able to use her tail to grab and throw things, as shown when she did this while fighting Moxxie to prevent him from killing Jimmy in "Unhappy Campers".
Endurance - Barbie has very high endurance to keep going, even against Blitzo and Moxxie and after getting hit with a block of heroin by her supplier.
Charisma - She can use her charm to manipulate humans, showcased in "Unhappy Campers" when she acted cutesy while making sexual gestures toward Jimmy so he did what she wanted.
Skillset

Combat prowess - She is very handy in hand-to-hand combat, as she was able to throw Moxxie with her tail easily. She takes on aggressive actions more, as she was able to fend off Moxxie and Blitzo by herself.
Acrobatics - She may be talented with acrobatics since her family owed a circus.
Stealth - Thanks to her Asmodean Crystal, she was able to blend in with the humans in Camp Ivannakummore in "Unhappy Campers".
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

Barbie Wire was born to Cash Buckzo and Tilla, alongside her twin brother Blitzo. Growing up, she lived and worked in the family's circus ran by her father and ringleader.

After the fire that Blitzo accidently caused and which killed their mother, Barbie disowned Blitzo and tried to get as far away from him as possible. At some point she ended up in a rehabilitation center to recover.

Months before "Unhappy Campers", Barbie had checked out of rehab and started selling and smuggling drugs on Earth at Camp Ivannakummore with help from Counselor Jimmy.[4]

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Unhappy Campers"

Undercover in Camp Ivannakummore, Barbie is smuggling drugs with Jimmy until he was killed by a stray firework whilst she fought Moxxie and Blitzo. As she leaves, she rudely reminds Blitzo that she wanted to never see him again and to not bother trying to find her anymore.

"Sinsmas"

When Blitzo goes to comfort Stolas about potentially losing Octavia, he mentions his sister, Barbie, and that he misses her every single day despite her hatred of him. He says that the two used to be close until the circus fire happened. Afterwards, he says it's a "shitty feeling" to have a family member that was once so close to you hate you, but also to not give up on them, because he hopes that Stolas will reconcile with Octavia just like he hopes to reconcile with Barbie.

ADVERTISEMENT

Gallery

Barbie Wire/Gallery
Trivia

Her name may be a pun on "Barbie" and "barbed wire".
Her first appearance was in the non-canon Helluva Boss pilot in a poster in Blitzo's office with a third imp named Tilla advertising them as "The Amazing Imp Siblings".
In the official series, the poster was changed to exclude Tilla and the text was changed to be "The Amazing Imp Twins".
In "Ozzie's", Blitzo has a picture of Barbie Wire and him as children, with their mother, who resembles Tilla.
In "Spring Broken", it is mentioned by Verosika Mayday that she was with Blitzo's sister during her stay in rehab, insulting her by claiming that rehab is for "sad, loser wash-ups". However, it is unclear if this was true or merely an insult to Blitzo.
In Barbie's debut episode, "Unhappy Campers", it is revealed that Barbie having resided in a rehab was true.
She is the second character to get official merchandise before her actual appearance in the Helluva Boss series, following Andrealphus, in her case, an enamel pin.
According to Donna Zammit, Barbie's default imp form was designed by Vivienne Medrano while her human form was designed by the collaborative efforts of Zammit herself, Vivienne Medrano, Amanda Heard, and Cécilia Goncalves.[5][6]
Additionally, Amanda Heard also designed Barbie's torn sleeveless jacket while Cécilia Goncalves designed her unique wristwatch.[7][6]
Because of her Asmodean Crystal, she is the first and so far the only imp to have a human disguise that is not merely a costume.
Also because of this, she is the first known imp to possess a crystal in the first place, as these are usually, if not only, given directly to Succubi by Asmodeus himself.
In Barbie Wire's social media profile, she lists "Acrobatics, endurance, stealth, improv, and labor" on her experience.
Despite being on bad terms with Blitzo, she doesn't pronounce the "o" in Blitzo's name the first time she sees him, as he prefers, but then pronounces it later on and Blitzo doesn't correct her.
Barbie Wire seems to be a smoker, as seen in her St. An's Hospital rehab profile on Blitzo's phone

"I would've thrown a bigger [party], but I couldn't convince Belphegor to let me break into her stash of party drugs. So fucking lame! I mean, I usually just steal them, but Belle changed the locks. She says I'm a total jackass for trying. But, hey... I'm proud to be a total jackass."

Belphegor is a minor character in Helluva Boss who made her official debut in the episode "Mastermind". She is one of the Seven Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Sloth.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Belphegor is a four-armed, lavender sheep/llama-like demon with long puffy wool acting as her hair. She has a melting black candle on her head with a pink flame, similar to the Baphomet demons, with the tips of her ears also resembling the melting wax dripping from her candle.

She has a pair of thin, black, pointed horns on top of her head, and her arms have a black-purple gradient that stops at her fingers, resembling fingerless gloves. She has five eyes on her face — one pair being her main eyes, with horizontally slit pale pupils and long lashes, the second pair slightly smaller, positioned just above her main eyes, and the last singular eye on her forehead. She also has an elongated white neck with five eyes vertically down the front, with three having black sclera, white irises and prominent lashes, and two being a blank purple.
Personality

While her personality is yet to be explored, being the sin of sloth, Belphegor is seen sleeping a lot. It is somewhat hinted that, similar to a few of her fellow Deadly Sins and other generally high-class demons, she seems to be apathetic for the lower-class, such as imps.

According to Beelzebub, she isn't fond of Beelzebub using her drugs, suggesting she hoards them or values her belongings more than her peers, although presumably, not the same extent as Mammon.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

Not much is known about Belphegor's history other than at some point she joined Lucifer as part of the Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Sloth.

Helluva Boss Season 1

"Queen Bee"

Belphegor is mentioned by Beelzebub in "Queen Bee". According to Beelzebub, Belphegor refused to let her steal from her stash of party drugs, and because of that, Belphegor changed the locks.

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Mastermind"

Belphegor appeared with the other Sins, overseeing the trial against I.M.P. She did not say anything during the proceedings and spent a good portion of it sleeping through the trial, only showing interest when there was movement near her or loud noises.

Relationships

Seven Deadly Sins

Beelzebub

While not having been shown interacting, during a conversation with Loona in "Queen Bee", Beelzebub implied she has a close relationship with Belphegor, even referring to her with the affectionate nickname "Belle".

Beelzebub apparently has the habit of stealing "party drugs" from Belphegor to use in her parties, enough that Belphegor has placed additional security by changing the locks on her cache of medicines and pills to stop Beelzebub from taking anymore. After Beelzebub failed to steal some of her drugs, Belphegor called Beelzebub a "jackass" for trying, but Beelzebub herself was unaffected by her insults and instead takes it in stride.

Others

Charlie Morningstar

While not having been shown interacting, Charlie has the Sin as one of her contacts in her phone.

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Skillset

Musical talent - During Satan's song, Belphegor and the rest of the Sins can be seen singing in a choir-esque fashion, backing up the former's vocals.
Gallery

Belphegor/Gallery
Trivia

Belphegor is based on the popular demon of the same name.
In Peter Binsfeld's classification of demons, Belphegor is one of the seven demons associated with the seven deadly sins, embodying the deadly sin of Sloth. Likewise, Belphegor in Helluva Boss is the embodiment of Sloth.
Belphegor is depicted as female in the Hellaverse, as opposed to her real-life demonological counterpart, who is usually depicted as a male. Although, in demonology, it was said that on some occasions, the demon would transform into a woman to seduce his victims.
The symbol that appears on the back of Belphegor's seat and on the rings Satan uses to strip Stolas' powers is the sigil of the real-world demon.
Belphegor's sheep-like appearance may be a reference to "counting sheep", a mental exercise used to help one fall asleep, which Belphegor frequently does.
Charlie's phone contacts
Belphegor's name on Charlie's phone contacts.
Due to Belphegor constantly waking up and sleeping, it is possible that she suffers from narcolepsy, a sleep disorder that causes excessive daytime sleepiness and can cause them to fall asleep suddenly.
The "Happy Pills" Stolas takes are branded to her name.
Belphegor is shown to be in Charlie Morningstar's phone contacts in the Hazbin Hotel episode "Dad Beat Dad".

Arrick "Burnie" Burnz was an imp demon and a minor antagonist in Helluva Boss who made his debut in the episode "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)".

He was an obsessive fan-turned-hater of Fizzarolli since at least fifteen years ago, harboring a desire to collaborate with him to an unhealthy degree.

Appearance

The younger Arrick was an imp demon with a slim physique, horns that curve inward, a somewhat messy haircut, and little strands of hair on his chin. He wore square glasses with blue lenses, a green T-shirt, and black pants.

In the present day, his appearance remains the same, albeit with some minor differences; he was taller and he has a slightly more muscular physique, the frames of his glasses are thicker, and his T-shirt has stains, and there are three splotches on the bottom left.
Personality

Arrick has an extreme obsession with Fizzarolli to the point of stalking, then dedicating his life to hating him, and even bringing a knife to make Fizzarolli listen to him. Arrick was very arrogant and selfish, showcased with his idea of being together with Fizzarolli as more of a master-pet relationship with Fizzarolli dressed in a gimp outfit with a chain leash and Arrick getting trophies showing he just cared about being famous and known.

Arrick was also shown to not care how uncomfortable he makes Fizzarolli with his sexual desires or hatred toward him. He also has a tendency to be overdramatic, shown when he believed that Fizzarolli coldly rejected him when it was his own creepy obsession that caused Fizzarolli to leave. Or how he overreacted when a teenage Blitzo lightly pushed him and Arrick acted like Blitzo brutally beat him.
Abilities

Agility - Arick showed some agility when he was following Fizzarolli in the shadows after Mammon's Concert when he was younger. He also managed to climb over a crowd as an adult.
History

Past

At some point after Arrick saw Fizzarolli's shows, he wanted to get into clown performing and became obsessed with him, even trying to sniff around Fizzarolli's dressing rooms.[1]

After Mammon's concert over fifteen years prior to "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", Arrick approached Fizzarolli and tried to push his ideas of the two of them performing together onto him. When Fizzarolli "rejected" him, he instantly switched from his #1 fan to his #1 hater. At some point, Arrick would then open a review blog dedicated to hating Fizzarolli.[1]

Helluva Boss Season 2

"MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)"

While Fizzarolli is attending a meet and greet with his fans, Arrick shows up and denounces Fizzarolli's career, scaring Fizzarolli into backing up against the wall until Blitzo jumps in and threatens to kill Burnie. Burnie continues taunting Fizzarolli, fantasizing about how their relationship would have been like, until Fizzarolli starts hyperventilating and Blitzo hits Burnie with his gun, forcing the stalker to leave.

As Asmodeus and Fizzarolli share a kiss in Fizzarolli's dressing room, Burnie kicks open the door while holding a dagger in order to forcefully have Fizzarolli listen to him. Blitzo then stops Burnie by killing him with a bullet to the head.

His review blog is called "fuckfizzbutnotinasexyway.complainer.com.org.gov".
Despite despising Fizzarolli, Arrick still owns some of his sex-bots, which apparently can't get him off right.[2]
Like Emberlynn Pinkle, he seems to represent the negative and disturbing aspects of fandoms. In his case, Arrick seems to represent parasocial relationships which do not respect the subject's privacy and personal space. He could go from loving to hating someone because they felt "disrespected", then he went to passionately hating on the subject they stopped liking.

C.H.E.R.U.B is a non-profit organization of cherub angels that protects the living on behalf of souls in Heaven. It made its debut in the titular episode.


ADVERTISEMENT
Background

C.H.E.R.U.B is seemingly Heaven's equivalent of I.M.P. Unlike their Hell-based counterparts, C.H.E.R.U.B offers free protection services for the living humans of Earth. Its known members include Cletus, Collin, and Keenie, though it is unknown if there are others, especially after the three were banned from returning to Heaven after accidentally killing Lyle Lipton. They have ads similar to the I.M.P ad complete with their own jingle.

Their goal is to save the lives of people in the living world because someone wants to keep them alive, whereas I.M.P's goal is the complete opposite, to kill people because someone wants them dead. A secondary goal C.H.E.R.U.B has is to try and help the saved person be worthy of ascending to Heaven when they die.

Unlike I.M.P, C.H.E.R.U.B doesn't take payment for its work, being a non-profit organization that does what it does because it considers it the right thing to do.
Gallery

C.H.E.R.U.B/Gallery
Trivia

The acronym spells out the word "cherub", which is befitting as its members are all Cherubs.
This is the first organization to not have its full name of its company acronym revealed, so it is currently unknown what the C.H.E.R.U.B abbreviation stands for.
The employees' names are all from countries famous for their shepherding. Collin and Keenie are Irish names, and Cletus is a Greek name.
Possible Scrapped or unused cherub
The fourth cherub
There was a lion Cherub who would have served as the fourth member and C.H.E.R.U.B's equivalent of Loona, but, was ultimately scrapped during production.[1]
For some unknown reason, C.H.E.R.U.B's commercials are also broadcasted on Hell's TV stations.
It's implied that C.H.E.R.U.B also try to help the people they save to get into Heaven, despite the fact no one knows the requirements necessary to pass divine judgement and ascend after death.
It is unknown if C.H.E.R.U.B is now disbanded since Cletus, Collin, and Keenie (the only ones who were seen working in the company) were banished from Heaven. Though, Deerie and the other Cherubs who appeared at the end of the titular episode may also be fellow employees.

Cash Buckzo[1][2] is the father of Blitzo and Barbie Wire, as well as the adoptive grandfather of Loona. He is the ring leader of his family circus and Fizzarolli's former boss.

He is a minor character who made his debut in "The Circus".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

00:00

Cash bears a similar resemblances to his son, but with the exception of having a small white goatee under his chin, dark circles under his eyes, his tail being mostly black, and his horn pattern being more triangular with black that stretched down the sides of his face, resembling sideburns. He also has thicker, longer fingers that are colored black, similar to his daughter's as an adult.

His normal attire (which is also his backstage attire) is that of a charcoal top hat with a rose-taupe band and patch sewn on the right side, a white Juliet-sleeved high-collared dress-shirt with thick vertical stripes colored in rose-taupe and faded-pink below the collar, stained baggy pants that sport the same appearance to his hat, and black heeled boots.

His stage outfit that he wears during performances consists of a dark purple top hat with a green band and a teal patch sewn on the right side, a green-striped long-sleeved shirt with a ruffled white collar and a small, dark purple bowtie with a green center, baggy pants that sport the same appearance to his hat, and black dress shoes.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Cash is presented as a manipulative and functionally bad father, at least towards Blitzo, evidenced by him emotionally manipulating his son to steal from the Goetia family against his son's better judgement.

Cash is incredibly greedy, heavily implied to hold little regard for his son, exchanging his son for $5 and a slim-fit condom from Paimon, with his ulterior motive towards doing this was to use his son to steal from the Goetia family.

In "Ghostf**kers", he was seen in a flashback striking his son, Blitzo, and blaming him for what happened in the fire, implying that he either cared for his wife and was distraught and angry over her death, or he cared about his circus business and it was all destroyed in the fire. Because of his anger and how he blames Blitzo, he goes as far as preventing him from visiting Fizzarolli in the hospital and lied that Fizzarolli didn't want to see him.
History

Past

At some point, Cash became the ringleader of the All-Imp Circus and met Tilla, with whom he had twins, Blitzo and Barbie Wire. He began to favor Fizzarolli, Blitzo's best friend, due to his talents and popularity even more than his son.

After one performance of his son and Fizzarolli, King Paimon negotiated a deal with Cash to arrange a playdate for Blitzo and his son Stolas, but before trading his son to Paimon, Cash instructed Blitzo to rob the royal mansion, exploiting Blitzo's love for his mother to get him to agree.[3] In the mansion, Blitzo started a game of pirates, thereby hiding the robbery, then threw the sack of stolen items from the balcony to Cash, who was hiding in the bushes outside.

Fifteen years prior to the events of "Oops", Cash was part of a birthday party for Fizzarolli where he gifted him a card with "Wish you were my son" on it just before the circus caught on fire and burned down.[4]

Cash survived the fire, unlike his wife, and blamed Blitzo for what happened, going so far as to slap him and later prevented him from visiting Fizzarolli in the hospital,[5] lying to him that Fizzarolli didn't want to see him.[4] What happened to Cash after this is currently unknown.

ADVERTISEMENT
Gallery

Trivia

Cash Buckzo's name is a combination of the words "cash" and "bucks", with both words being alternate words for money, highlighting his greedy attitude.
Before Vivziepop gave him a name, he was referred to as "Goatzo" by character designer, Cécilia Goncalves, during production.[6][2]
He and Paimon share the same voice actor, with both being voiced by Jonathan Freeman.
Development

In concept art for Cash, it is shown that his initial design had longer horns with spikes part way along them, but were simplified with the spikes removed due to time constraints on animation

The unnamed catfish monster was once a regular catfish from Earth that was transformed into a hellish behemoth after being exposed to Verosika Mayday's flask of Beelzejuice, which mutated it.

It was a minor character which made its debut in "Spring Broken".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

00:00

The creature was previously a normal teal catfish, but after its mutation, it grew in massive size, growing legs and a long prehensile tongue.

Its scales turned gray with hints of pale blue and had cyan-colored claws and eyes. Its whiskers, gills, and some speckles gave a bio-luminescent white glow. Despite being a mutated catfish it resembles other aquatic creatures.
History

Helluva Boss Season 1

"Spring Broken"

While enthralling the crowd at her concert, Verosika threw her flask of Beelzejuice to the crowd. It bounced on several beachgoers before landing in the shallow waters of the beach where the catfish was swimming. The fish was soaked in the drink and, almost immediately, the catfish underwent its transformation.

Shortly after its mutation, the creature went on a rampage at the beach, where it killed several humans and pulled an inebriated Moxxie with its tongue into its mouth. Millie threw a Molotov cocktail at the monster, causing it to fall back into the sea. She then leapt at the beast and forced its mouth open where Moxxie was.

However, since Moxxie was too drunk to reach her hand, Millie cut the monster's tongue off to free him. Moxxie was launched out of the fish's mouth, while Millie escaped by punching its wounded tongue, before climbing up its face.

The fish threw Millie into the air and swallowed her as she fell, only for Millie to cut the fish open from the inside, killing the beast.

ADVERTISEMENT

Trivia

It shares the same voice actress as Sallie May, both being voiced by Morgana Ignis.
Interestingly, the fact that the catfish was in the ocean implies it was able to live in salty bodies of water, whereas most catfish are freshwater fish. The exact species of catfish is unknown but it is likely it could be a Hardhead catfish, since that species is known to be caught in ocean areas.

Chazwick Thurman was a minor antagonist of Helluva Boss who made his debut in "Exes and Oohs".

He was the ex-boyfriend of Moxxie and Millie, whom convinced Crimson to let him marry the mob boss' son in order to join his mafia and leech off the family's money.

Appearance

Chazwick appears as a tall, shark-like demon, having gray-toned skin with a lighter underside; his fins also sport a similar pattern, but have dark green accents and white spots on their ends. He has 3 gills on each side of his body and his sclera are neon blue with white rings.

He is missing a tooth on the right side and he has a small scar on his right eye. He also has two scars on his chest and a scar on his upper left arm. He has short, evergreen hair that sticks upwards, with dark horns protruding from his head.

He also sports sea green teeth and a long tail where that is missing its skin having jagged ends with light tips. He dons a gray striped shirt that's topped by a navy green jacket with white accents and bone designs on its sleeves.

His pants are the same color, which are tied by a belt with a bone buckle; his shoes are dark having green tips on the front. He also wears a small, gray fedora on his head.
Personality

Chaz presents himself to the world as a cocky jokester, heavily full of himself, thinking that he's someone everyone wants to be with. However, he has been shown to be very calm and charismatic, as shown by Moxxie during their inital relationship.

He does not respect a person's boundaries as seen when attempting to sleep with Moxxie despite his offers being rejected, even going as far as to attempt to sleep with Millie folllowing being rejected by Moxxie, who would get violent and enraged at the sight of him, and then with Blitzo right after getting kicked out Millie's room.

Chaz puts himself first, as evidenced when he abandoned Moxxie during a failed heist, choosing to recover bags of money instead of rescuing Moxxie, furthermore he was shown to be willing to let Crimson force Moxxie marry him, despite the latter's clear protest. Chaz's room (or, presumably, Moxxie's former room) also has a lot of portraits of Chaz himself. This speaks of an overestimated opinion of himself, as well as narcissism.

He is shown to be very self absorbed, as he repeatedly brags about how big his penis is and about his sexual affairs, even when asleep after having sex with Blitzo, he mutters on how huge his own penis is. He also complains about the chairs not being filled during his wedding ceremony. He was also shown to be greedy, sexually preoccupied, and dishonest, as he attempted to join Crimson's mob family through deception and fraud.

He repeats around others that he is rich, despite actually being evicted and missing payments. However, this deceit led him to his cruel death when Blitzo revealed to Crimson that Chaz is actually broke and does not represent Crimson's real interests.

Chaz is not particularly intelligent. His scheme to ingratiate himself into Crimson's criminal family involved faking his wealth and marrying in via Moxxie, but his plans failed to account for the fact he had no money to offer Crimson, with the likely fact his deception would be quickly discovered had his scheme succeeded. Furthermore, he failed to take into account the negative disposition Moxxie would have towards him, considering how he had abandoned Moxxie previously.

Chaz does appear to possibly hold some small amount of guilt or apprehension. During the failed bank heist, Chaz appeared visually concerned for Moxxie's safety, and when choosing to rescue the money instead of Moxxie, he appeared ashamed of his actions. Whether he felt genuinely ashamed, or he simply was disappointed he had seemingly lost an opportunity to marry into Crimson's family is unknown. Nonetheless, he appeared to not hold any regrets by the time he reunited with Moxxie, or at least failed to express any regret.
Abilities

Ocular Illumination - Similarly to the imps, Chazwick's eyes emitted a blue glow.
Skillset

Weapon Proficiency - Chaz was shown to be good with weapons, as he helped Moxxie in combat between other gangsters, therefore it can be inferred that he is supposedly skilled in shooting and using weapons.
Manipulation - Chaz is fairly competent at manipulating other people, as shown when he was able to form relationships with Moxxie and Millie. However, his actual flirting is absurd and inappropriate, but rather, it is due to his aggressive desire to have sex and get what he wants, using whatever attraction his target has to his advantage, as shown when he wins Blitzo over by offering him secrets of his exes. Furthermore, he was able to somehow convince Crimson that he had become rich with no suspicion until Blitzo loudly exposes his lie.
Driving - He is shown to own (and sleep in) a car which Blitzo breaks into.

Trivia

His license plate says "HGECOK", a play on words of "huge c***", something he claims to have.
Despite this, Blitzo comments that Chaz is "really bad in bed".
From a neon sign that says "Big Dicks" shown in the song Chaz Time, it could imply he has two penises.[2] This may reflect how real-life sharks have two penises known as claspers.
Chazwick Thurman Tribute
Chaz's memorial tribute at the end of episode "Exes and Oohs"
Chaz is killed off-screen by Crimson, with the former's death being confirmed at the end-credits scene where Crimson frames Chaz's severed jaw on the wall along with the severed jaws, wings, and horns of other demons that were killed.
His name might be a reference to the late American actor Chadwick Boseman, who was most notable for his portrayal of the Marvel Comics superhero Black Panther in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).
A picture in Moxxie's room has a poster of him with "nice c***" labeled, similarly to the meme of the same name.
Judging by his multiple eviction notices and bills, and the fact he rented clothes from the Mammon company, Chaz was quite poor or possibly owed a lot of debt with other demons, as he was evicted from his home for non-payment of taxes.
As seen on "Chaz's Mastur Plan" and the way he spells Moxxie's name as "Moksie", Chaz is bad at spelling, a similarity he shares with Blitzo.
During the dinner scene, the food served between him, I.M.P, and Crimson are salmon sushi/steak - the same sushi that can be seen after Millie cuts one of Crimson's goons in half - implying that Chaz is something of a cannibal.
Chaz's name was decided by the team wanting "the most fuckboy name". Vivienne added on that she was deciding between "Chaz" and "Chad".[3]
Chaz's tail design was based on the tail of Thresher sharks.[4]
Seeing as how Chaz can be seen wearing the same suit throughout Moxxie's flashbacks, it is implied that he has been renting it up until the events of his debut episode.

Cherubs are a subspecies of angel native to Heaven.


ADVERTISEMENT
Description


1/2


Cherubs are purportedly tasked with protecting the lives of living, endangered or suicidal humans, showering them with love to give them a reason to continue to live. These tasks are suggested to be done at the request of the deceased souls residing in Heaven, who want them to live whether they knew them personally or out of gratitude for helping them while alive. From what Keenie implied, they also try to redeem living humans so they can enter Heaven under the assumption that good people are automatically sent there after death.

Unlike the lower-ranking demons such as imps, Cherubs appear capable of generating a portal to travel between the living world and Heaven without any outside help. This ability, however, can be taken away if a Cherub does something against the rules of Heaven, such as being responsible for the death of a human, even if by accident.

There is a hotspot in Heaven for cherubs known as Cherub Towne.
Cultural relations

Demons, specifically Imps, have very low opinions on Cherubs. Blitzo refers to them as "Heaven's table scraps". Millie got upset with C.H.E.R.U.B's hypocrisy about I.M.P meddling with the lives of humans despite doing the same. There is an arcade game which demons can shoot Cherub targets.

Biology

Appearance

Keenie, a female anthropomorphic cherub
Keenie, a female anthropomorphic cherub
Cletus, a male human-like cherub
Cletus, a male human-like cherub
Cherubs are roughly the size of a human child. They have the bodies of animals, usually of sheep, lamb, bees, deer, or humans of infantile proportions, with pastel color schemes.

Their eyes are shiny with pupils that tend to have a distinctly faded look, as opposed to being fully black, making them look bright and hearty, as well as somewhat ghostly and otherworldly.

Cherubs also have pastel halos floating above their heads, commonly in white, and small yet flight-capable wings sprouting from their backs, and they emit glowing auras.

Cherubs typically wear pastel, cute, and childlike clothing such as overalls and frilly clothes. Most accessorize with ribbons and bowties.

Abilities

Flight - All Cherubs are capable of flight via their wings.
Superhuman strength - In the commercial for C.H.E.R.U.B, Keenie is shown lifting a boulder several times her own size with relative ease.
Pyligenesis - Cherubs can open a gateway to travel between Heaven and Earth. However, cherubs who fail to do their responsibilities are unable to re-enter Heaven.
Object manipulation - Cherubs can conjure numerous items in or out of existence. Deerie demonstrated this ability by summoning a pair of reading glasses alongside a clipboard out of thin air, whereas the C.H.E.R.U.B employees erased a makeshift noose that Lyle was preparing to hang himself with.
Weapon summoning - Cherubs can summon holy weapons at will. These weapons appear to be unique to the individual. The lethality of these weapons, and if they are comparable to exorcists' angelic weapons, is unknown.
Telekinesis - Only Deerie, a suggested higher ranking Cherub, has displayed this ability. She used her telekinesis to make a clip board float in the air.
Bioluminescence - Cherubs have a light glowing aura around them, specifically outside of Heaven.
Mortality

In "The Full Moon", Keenie mentions that they need to eat to live, implying that Cherubs can starve to death and need to eat to survive. They are also capable of being harmed by human weaponry, displayed when D.H.O.R.K.S. subdued Cletus with a tranquilizer dart, and tased Collin and Keenie with a regular taser.

ADVERTISEMENT
Gallery

Cherub game targets
Cherub game targets
Trivia

In Abrahamic religion, Cherubs (or Cherubim) are one of the many attendants of God with varying roles and are entrusted with all sorts of important duties. The Book of Ezekiel depicts the forms of Cherubs as rather terrifying, but awe-inspiring: they have four wings and four faces (human, bull on the left, lion on the right, and eagle) with hoof-like feet, and having an aura like burning fire while gleaming like copper.
Contrary to their appearance in the Bible, Cherubs are popularly depicted as winged infants in Western media. This depiction was born from Western Renaissance Art using Putti from Greek mythology in paintings that depicted Angels, which Cletus resembles.
Blitzo's comment of Cherubs being "Heaven's table-scraps" may imply the cherubs are in the lower hierarchical rankings of Heaven. While it may match the angelic hierarchy of Jewish texts, this may also be ironic given the Christian Cherubs were considered of exceptional high ranking and closer to God than other angels, second only to Seraphim angels.
There seems to be a ranking system between cherubs, as it is implied Deerie is C.H.E.R.U.B's superior.
Possible Scrapped or unused cherub
The unused lion cherub
The version of Cherubs depicted in Helluva Boss draws more from the pop-culture version of the Angel as winged infants with "cute animal" themes mixed in. The Biblical concept of the Cherubim was noted during the creation process, before it was decided to expand upon the pop-culture versions due to Helluva Boss being a cartoon and didn't have to strictly follow the Biblical depiction.[2]
Other scripture-related animal themes were explored in development, such as lions and donkeys, the former being a reference to the passage, "The Lion and the Lamb".[2] This included a scrapped cherub based on a lion that would have served as the parallel to Loona.[2]
The Cherub game targets are of a bird, fawn, and lion cub.
The trio of Cletus, Collin, and Keenie from C.H.E.R.U.B, are the first cherubs shown to be banished from Heaven. In "The Full Moon", it is shown that they commit petty crimes to survive, but later team up with the members of D.H.O.R.K.S. to get revenge on I.M.P.
Cherubs are the first known subspecies of angels confirmed to have entered Hell outside of the Pride Ring.
It is likely that Lucifer Morningstar has travelled to the other rings of Hell, as is he the ruler of all of Hell, but there has been no on-screen confirmation that he has done so.

"Okay, guys, it's time. Now's our moment. Remember everything that horny little fudge-knuckle did to us because now we make him pay. For the humans, for the heavens, and most of all for us! Let's go kick some ass!"
―Cletus, to Collin and Keenie
Cletus is a cherub angel who appears in the Helluva Boss episode "C.H.E.R.U.B". He is a former member of C.H.E.R.U.B and is a supporting antagonist alongside Keenie and Collin.

He was later banished from Heaven alongside his co-workers due to indirectly killing a human. Later, in "The Full Moon", he and his co-workers joined with the agents of D.H.O.R.K.S. to take revenge on I.M.P.

Appearance

Cletus is a small cherub who takes the appearance of a white-skinned human baby with short, light coral puffed hair, a small light pink nose, and large periwinkle eyes with no irises or pupils. He also has pale rosy cheeks.

His outlines, eyebrows, and eyelashes are colored in a shade of dark purple. He also sports a white halo hovering above his head, and a pair of periwinkle-and-white feathered wings on his back.

Cletus wears a pair of coral overalls over a light yellow shirt with a white peter-pan collar, and periwinkle flats.
Personality

Like his fellow cherubs, Cletus is very optimistic and tries his best to save Lyle Lipton, although he is the one who ends up killing him by accident.

While usually happy and carefree, Cletus is shown to get very angry when I.M.P gets in the way of his attempts to save Lyle; he even goes far as trying to shoot them multiple times with a bow.

He also appears to be incredibly self righteous, even more so than his colleagues. He even acknowledges the man he's trying to save is a terrible person and by that extent, seemingly knowing he's beyond their help, but, he's determined to save him, anyway.

However, this appears to be more out of obligation to his job rather than any moral obligation. He appears to get rather emotional, as shown when he started to cry after being expelled from Heaven.
Abilities

Flight - Along with all the other abilities of Cherubs, Cletus can fly due to his wings, and can fly quite quickly and is swift with his wings in battle, even though his wings are quite small.
Weapon Summoning - Like all other Cherubs, Cletus has the ability to summon an angelic crossbow that's unique to him, as well as golden arrows to load it with. When released from the crossbow, these arrows leave behind a visible trail of bright sparkling golden light.
Skillset

Musical Talent - He is shown to have the ability to sing well in the beginning of the episode "C.H.E.R.U.B".
Exoskeleton Proficiency - along with his colleagues, Cletus is capable of piloting and fighting with the weaponized exoskeletons provided by D.H.O.R.K.S.
Gallery

Cletus/Gallery
Trivia

Like his colleagues, Cletus's name derives from a country famous for shepherding. In his case, "Cletus" is a Greek name.
Cletus is currently the only known humanoid Cherub, as all the other Cherubs seen thus far are anthropomorphic animals such as lambs, fawns, and bumblebees.
He shares the same voice actor as Wally Wackford, Travis, and Mister Butler, with the four of them being voiced by Don Darryl Rivera.
With the trio from C.H.E.R.U.B being a mirror of I.M.P, Cletus can be seen as the parallel of Blitzo, as both are the leaders of their respective teams.

Collin is a cherub angel who appears in the Helluva Boss episode "C.H.E.R.U.B". He is a former member of C.H.E.R.U.B and is a supporting antagonist alongside Keenie and Cletus.

He is later banished from Heaven alongside his co-workers due to indirectly killing a human. Later, in "The Full Moon", he and his co-workers joined with the agents of D.H.O.R.K.S. to attempt taking revenge on I.M.P.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


2/2


Collin is a small cherub who takes the appearance of an anthropomorphic sheep with white freckles and dark periwinkle skin, as well as paler periwinkle short hair that is puffed upwards. His eyes are periwinkle with lighter upper eyelids.

His outlines and eyebrows are colored in a shade of dark purple, and he also sported a white halo hovering above his head, and a pair of two-toned periwinkle feathered wings on his back. His legs are light periwinkle with white round markings, and dark periwinkle heart-shaped hooves.

His outfit is that of a long-sleeved light blue turtleneck with a periwinkle-and-white-striped bowtie.
Personality

Collin is sweet, sensitive, and soft-spoken. Like the rest of C.H.E.R.U.B, Collin is dedicated to his job, going as far as to target anyone who interferes.

However, he is the only one who is genuinely committed toward the message of good will the organization delivers, having shown care for his clients and explaining to them the positive aspects of living to lift their hopes, as opposed to his colleagues who seem to only help out of obligation.

Collin appears to hold the most restraint out of the three, hardly uttering foul language and is the least quick to resort to anger. Even toward the inappropriate actions of I.M.P, Collin, while frustrated, merely chided them for their malicious behavior and was flabbergasted as to why they were constantly trying to interfere.

When he's worried, angered or nervous, Collin starts to stutter, and he will nearly use God's name in vain. Notably being the only time he ever comes close to swearing.

Counselor Jimmy[2] was a minor character who made his debut in the Helluva Boss episode "Unhappy Campers".

He was one of the camp counselors of Camp Ivannakummore and the former drug supplier of Barbie Wire. He was killed by a stray firework while Barbie Wire fought Blitzo and Moxxie.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Jimmy was a short, tan Caucasian male, with brown hair, and slight goatee, he also appears to slouch a bit. He wears big round glasses, a green shirt, a Camp Ivannakummore hat, and brown shorts. He also carries a whistle.
Personality

Although, Jimmy appears meek and timid, he does have a dark side as shown through his smuggling massive quantities of drugs and murdering a co-worker who just so happened to stumble across them.

He easily gets manipulated by Barbie, or, at the very least, by anyone he finds attractive enough to do their bidding for.
History

Past

Sometime ago, Jimmy met Barbie Wire and began working with her to supply drugs in the human world. Jimmy later killed another camp counselor who found Barbie's drugs. Knowing the counselor couldn't swim, Jimmy drilled holes inside of one of the canoes and waited for the counselor to use one of them at night so he would drown.[3]

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Unhappy Campers"

Later, Jimmy was unknowingly spotted by Millie and Moxxie secretly transporting a bag full of money and drugs, as well as the drill he used to set up his co-workers demise, and heading into the locked boathouse. Later on, Jimmy was confronted by Moxxie and Blitzo in the boathouse, with Moxxie attempting to kill Jimmy and Barbie stopping the attempts until a firework from Millie's concert flies in and accidentally kills Jimmy.

ADVERTISEMENT

Trivia

According to Vivienne Medrano, Jimmy was designed to be 18 or 19 years old, and added that in the states, camp counselors usually have to be legal adults.[1]
He shares the same voice actor as Vaggie in the pilot and the Hellhound Adoption Center Lady in "Seeing Stars", with all of them being voiced by Monica Franco.

Crimson is Moxxie's father and the head of a powerful mafia organization in the Greed Ring. He is an antagonist who made his debut in the Helluva Boss episode "Exes and Oohs".

He invites I.M.P over to his estate so that he could marry his son over to Chazwick Thurman, under the assumption that Chaz was rich. In "Oops", Crimson hires Striker for a big score and later uses Fizzarolli as a hostage to extort Asmodeus.

Appearance

Crimson is a quite tall imp demon, standing closer in height to Blitzo, with white hair, black and white striped horns, and yellow sclera. Around his eyes are white markings, with the right being larger than the left. He possesses a crooked and bent tail with white accents near the base and on the middle of his tail fork.

His appearance is similar to his son Moxxie, with similar hair and shape of his horns, however larger and slightly more jagged. Unlike his son, Crimson's skin is a darker shade of red and his legs appear to be plantigrade, rather than digitigrade. One of Crimson's fangs has been replaced with a golden fang.

Crimson's attire consists of a red high-collar shirt that grips his neck, topped by a navy blue coat with light blue accents, thin red stripes, red buttons, and red lining. His pants are dark blue which also have thin red stripes, and his shoes are black and red-heeled dress shoes. He also wears a black fedora with a red and white band.
Personality

Crimson is a vicious and extremely ruthless crime boss that controls a large army of shark-demon gangsters. He is shown to have been horrifically abusive towards Moxxie since his childhood, constantly levying physical and psychological abuse towards Moxxie, and by extension his wife.

He cultivates an aura of fear in those that know him, even towards his own family members and close associates like Moxxie and Chazwick. Ultimately, his greed and power come first to him, and he harbors no remorse for his victims. This comes to the point that he appears mentally prepared to kill blood-related family members, such as his wife and Moxxie, to advance his personal goals.

Despite this, he is capable of exhibiting a seemingly jovial, warm, happy, and even charismatic presence when he chooses to do so, such as during his initial meeting with Blitzo and Millie, or during moments when he feels comfortable. However, he can be quick to discard this external display of affection as required.

Crimson is extremely prejudiced, having demonstrated to be chauvinistic and sexist towards women, as well as homophobic of his son's orientation. He would often refer to Millie as being a dame, broad, beard, and other similarly negative terminologies.

He displays a lack of knowledge regarding concepts of sexuality, believing Moxxie's statement of being bisexual to simply mean he is homosexual, with Crimson disregarding his son's bisexuality and claiming he is simply gay and hiding that by marrying a woman, as claimed by his declaration of Millie being merely a "beard" for Moxxie. He furthermore holds bizarre beliefs as to what kind of home décor and wedding decorations/dresses homosexuals enjoy, such as decorating his home with a wide array of dildos in an attempt to placate Moxxie and forcing his son to wear a dress while forcibly attempting to marry him off.
Abilities

Skillset

Leadership - Crimson has corralled himself to be the leader of a large, and seemingly powerful mafia, wielding absolute and unquestioned authority.
Manipulation - As the leader of the criminal organization, Crimson keeps his business afloat through blackmail, threats, and violence and ensures efficiency in underlings. He also executed a long-term game of psychological manipulation towards his son, Moxxie, having cowed his son to the point that he exhibits extreme deference and, initially, obedience towards Crimson.
Weapon Proficiency - He has been shown to be proficient in the usage of a knife, being able to quickly and expertly throw it at a long-range target, and hit the target accurately.
Gallery

Crimson/Gallery
Trivia

The word "Crimson" is a dark shade of red.
It is possible his surname may also be "Knolastname" after Moxxie's surname, "Knolastname", however, it is yet to be confirmed.
Crimson's occupation as a mob boss was foreshadowed in "Murder Family", when, while discussing killing a "shitty dad, or a mob family", Moxxie quotes "That's understandable." from The Godfather.
The accent Moxxie speaks in to say such a quote also indicates another key factor about Crimson; his heavy New York accent.
It is possible that it was also foreshadowing to their vendetta.
He shares the same voice actor as his son, Moxxie, with both being voiced by Richard Horvitz.
The names of Crimson and his bodyguard, Alessio, can be viewed as "Crim n' Al", a joke on the word "criminal".[1]
It was confirmed in a livestream that Crimson's death stare is based off of Stewie Griffin's from Family Guy.[citation needed]
