The Greed Ring is one of the seven Rings of Hell that was first seen in "Loo Loo Land".

Like the other rings in Hell, the Greed Ring is accessible and traversable by Hellborn species, while the Sinners can not due to being confined to and can only exist in the top ring, Pride.[1]

Description

The Greed Ring appears to be a rundown city and industrial area with rampant criminal and gang activity. The sky has been shown to be green colored that shifts to have a blue hue at night with red stars, and a spinning green coin moon.[2]

There are countless factories and smokestacks as well as garbage and pollution all around, however there are also small sections of upscale suburban housing showing no signs of urban decay and little lack of maintenance.

Trivia

The realm is likely alluding to the Nine Circles that originates from Dante Alighieri's Divine Comedy. Greed in particular is said to be the fourth circle, and is reserved for the materialistic condemned.
The Greed Ring was the second of the seven rings to be introduced.
It is likely that Mammon might rule, or at least reside in this ring, given that his investments, such as Loo Loo Land, are present, which is consistent with Mammon as the prince of Greed in Binsfeld's classification of demons. This is further supported in his influence in the city of the Greed Ring, as seen in "Exes and Oohs".
According to the "Verosika's Hell Tour" and "Mammon's Clown Pageant" shirt merchandise, the Greed Ring has a location called "Mint City".[3][4] However, it is currently not known whether the information listed on the shirt is canon in the show.
Additionally, also listed in the "Mammon's Clown Pageant" shirt merchandise, the Greed Ring has a location called "Mammopolis".[5][6] However, is is currently not known whether the information listed on the shirt are also canon in the show.
The name "Mint City" could be a reference to the how a mint is a place where currency is minted. This may imply that Hell's currency, Souls, is produced in this city.
It is revealed in "Exes and Oohs", that Moxxie grew up in the Greed Ring. However, this contradicts his stating he was native to the Wrath Ring from "The Harvest Moon Festival".
It is later clarified by writer Adam Neylan that Moxxie was born in Wrath but was raised and spent most of his life in Greed.[7]
It was revealed in the episode "Exes and Oohs", that there is an elevator for helicopters to traverse to Greed.

"As punishment for their reckless act, Heaven cast Lucifer and his love into the dark pit he had created, never allowing him to see the good that came from humanity, only the cruel and the wicked."
―The description of Hell from the "Story of Hell" book

Hell is the primary setting of both Hazbin Hotel and Helluva Boss. It is where both sinners and hellborn demons reside.

Description

Hell is the supernatural realm of demons. It is inhabited by a population of indigenous hellborn which are demons that were born in Hell, and sinners are Humans who have died and have had their souls sent to Hell.

The atmosphere is presented as perpetually choleric, disorderly, and noxious, though capable of supporting carbon-based lifeforms. Hell's geography is divided into Seven Rings, as first revealed by the lyrics in "You Will Be Ok". Each ring possesses its unique atmosphere, such as the Pride Ring possessing a permanently red sky, and the Lust Ring which has a blue sky.

Hellborn demons have the ability to traverse across any of the rings, made easily accessible via an extensive elevator network, whereas sinner demons are confined to the top-most ring, the Pride Ring, by methods and reasons unknown.[2]

Hell's society is incredibly chaotic due to the unstable and hostile disposition of its populace. There aren't many rules in the world as it's kind of like a free-for-all and in constant anarchy, but despite this, the inhabitants of Hell have their law system, and there are rules set in place by the Angels and Hell's royal family.[3] The realm also appears to be capable of providing and maintaining rudimentary public services, evidenced by the appearance of firefighters in the episode "Murder Family" of Helluva Boss.

Within Hell's civilization, there exists a crude form of hierarchy[4] defined by power,[5] with all of Hell being ruled by a king, the fallen angel Lucifer Morningstar, whose daughter and heir apparent is Princess Charlie.[6]

The levels of this hierarchy are broken up from top-to-bottom as follows:[7]

Lucifer Morningstar - The King of Hell
Charlie Morningstar - The Princess of Hell, heir apparent to Hell's throne
The Seven Deadly Sins - Demons who embody one of the seven deadly sins
The Ars Goetia - Hellborn Demons with royal and noble status
Overlords - Demons who wield considerable power/influence
Sinners - Immortal Demons who were once humans on Earth, having sinned, were damned to Hell
Hellborn demons - Succubi, Incubi, and other species of demons native to Hell
Imps and Hellhounds - The bottom of Hell's society
Even though the Seven Deadly Sins are on the same level of hierarchy, there seems to be at least some hierarchy between them; Lucifer, being a Fallen Angel and the King of Hell, has authority over, and is ranked separately above the others, however, with his absence, Satan fills in as the leader, showing that Satan has more influence and authority than the other five.

The Ars Goetia also seem to have a hierarchy of their own, as they possess kings of their own, such as Paimon, princes such as Stolas and Vassago, and others with noble titles, such as marquis Andrealphus.

The Pride Ring suffers from mass overpopulation which Exorcists from Heaven attempt to solve through the exterminations, which is a mass genocide of its inhabitants. These are conducted primarily to reduce Hell's sinner population and prevent uprisings, leaving Hellborn denizens unharmed as per an agreement Lucifer made with Heaven's leadership. Charlie aims to stop this by giving sinners a chance to rehabilitate and redeem themselves by checking into her hotel and later ascending to Heaven.

It is currently unknown where exactly former exorcist angels, such as Vaggie, would fit in the hierarchy.
History

Thousands of years ago, after Lucifer gave humanity free will by offering Eve the Fruit of Knowledge, because of this, Hell was accidentally created when evil entered into the Earth. After Lucifer and Lilith were cast into Hell, Lucifer became its ruler but lost his will to dream, becoming reclusive, but Lilith thrived in Hell, using her voice and her songs to empower all of demonkind and allowing Hell to grow stronger every day,[8] until an annual Extermination was put in place to prevent Hell from rising against Heaven.

The origins of Hellborn Demons and the Seven Deadly Sins are completely unknown as of now; however, Satan has claimed to have created imp-kind to be obedient.

At some point a hierarchy was set to distinguish demons based on status. Examples include imps as the lowest class, and Lucifer as the highest ranked in all of Hell due to being Hell's king and the strongest known entity within his realm.
Rules & Law Enforcement

Despite its chaotic environment, Hell has laws and rules of its own known as "demon law". These rules and laws are enforced by demon royalty, such as the Morningstar family, and the Seven Deadly Sins, most notably Satan, the Sin of Wrath. Demons who break these laws will face trial and punishment.
Known Rules and Laws

Sinners are unable to leave the Pride Ring.
Sinners can advertise media outside the Pride Ring, however.
Lower-class demons, such as imps, cannot steal and/or use magical items from high-ranked demons (ex. Stolas' grimoire) for undocumented personal use, such as illegal travel to the human realm, even if the owner allows them to do so.
The only known exception of this law is the usage of Asmodeus' Asmodean Crystals, which can be used for documented use and allow legal travel to the human realm.
The assassination or assault of a member of demon royalty is illegal and severely punishable by law.
Betrayal from a member of demon royalty (ex. the Ars Goetia) is considered treason.
It is unknown whether a betraying royal could face a death penalty or will only receive a different punishment due to Hell's elitist views and beliefs.
Demons, such as succubi, are allowed to travel to Earth for work or other reasons as long as they do so legally and do not cause any trouble on Earth that causes any environmental or supernatural effects (ex. mutating a catfish into a giant monster).
Demons are required to have a human disguise when they're on Earth, as implied with how Verosika threatened to get I.M.P in trouble and how Loona reprimanded them for going to Earth without human disguises in "Spring Broken".
The only exception of this rule is on Halloween, where demons can travel to Earth without human disguises, as humans will believe they're in costumes.
As of now, it is unknown if Sinners can face consequence for breaking demon law, as Hellborn demons are, so far, the only demons shown to face consequence. It is also unknown if the exemption of Hellborn demons from the Exterminations fit as a demon law due to it being an agreement between both Heaven and Hell.

A species of demons known as Reapers act as the law enforcement of Hell. Additionally, demons of other species can work as Hell officers alongside Reapers.

Certain laws that apply on Earth appear to apply in Hell as well, as shown in the Greed Ring in "Exes and Oohs", robbing a bank is illegal and can lead to jail time, though the specifics of jail time and the law in hell are unknown.

Trivia

Vivziepop's original depiction of Hell as a location was first featured in her popular web-comic, ZooPhobia; it was one that the characters of Hazbin Hotel were originally due to fit in with, and that featured in her third-year short-film, Son of 666.
Vivziepop confirmed that her Hellaverse and Zoophobia do not share the same universe or version of Hell, stating that their separate Hell theologies are not compatible.[9]
In fact, according to Vivziepop, the Hell of ZooPhobia focuses much more on mythological figures inspired by various world religions such as the Deities. Rather than the Hellaverse which is more of a personal representation of Hell by Vivziepop herself.[10]
The Hell setting of both Hazbin Hotel and Helluva Boss draws its inspiration from a variety of sources. Vivziepop stated that she didn’t want the show to be limited to the perspective of one specific text or religion, instead wanting it to be much broader in concept.[11] However, within that idea, Vivziepop did incorporate many characters and details from popular demonology texts, such as Dante's Inferno and The Lesser Key of Solomon.
Vivziepop does think that Hell has its own demonic languages, but also that the language logic of the world was such that it "went without saying" and that English was only spoken as default as a kind of stand-in for the language of the show.[12]
Hell runs just like a "big sleazy city", and everything in Hell is off-brand and of terrible quality, including the movies. Vivziepop thinks there would be a lot of public-domain cartoons on TV.[13]
Hell is a very violent place where fights and aggression are common, but the only way a resident can be truly killed (i.e. their existence is permanently erased), or have serious bodily harm inflicted, is with Angelic weaponry. There is a black market for the Angel-adorned weapons, which are brought to Hell by the Exorcists during their yearly exterminations, and are then are collected by the residents of Hell.[14]
Vivziepop played with the idea that, when a sinner is killed, their "dark energy" seeps into the ground to become part of the living fabric of Hell, hence why some objects and buildings appear to be 'alive'. She discussed a part of Hell that she planned to explore (if she was given the scope to do so) called Wonderland, where a great deal of this energy had collected and so is full of the most horrifying and dangerous monsters.[15][16]
Hell has its varied geography and climate, including jungles and forests, and its own native creatures. Everything in Hell is dangerous, inhospitable, and terrifying.[17]
There are many cities in Hell beyond Pentagram City, however, Vivziepop stated that most of Hazbin Hotel will take place within the main city.[18]
The main setting for Helluva Boss, and the location of the company's offices, is another city within the Pride Ring called Imp City, where many imp demons reside. It resembles a business district.
There is an area of Hell called the Cannibal Town, where many of Hell's cannibal population reside. It resembles a classic Americana town that is stuck in the 1910s, drawing inspiration from Hello Dolly!.[19][note 1] This location can be seen in Alastor's comic, as he briefly passes through the area.
Although Vivziepop was still working out the details, and thought that much of it would function on "cartoon logic", she thought it made sense for sinners to arrive in a location in Hell that was relevant to their geographical location on Earth.[20] She joked that there is a nice town for the Canadians in Hell called "Heck".[21][22]
The seas of Hell are a dark gray/blackish color.[23]
There is seemingly oxygen in Hell as evidenced by Moxxie's statement in the episode "C.H.E.R.U.B", where he exclaims he was "losing oxygen" after being buried under debris.
In the ADDICT music video and "Ozzie's", it is shown that it can rain in Hell. Alastor mentions in "Scrambled Eggs" that there can be acid rain.
Allergies do exist in Hell and are part of the numerous inconveniences that occur at regular intervals. According to Vivziepop, life in hell consists of periods of stability, followed by periods of unpleasantness, which everyone is forced to deal with together.[24]
Vivziepop joked that the only song available to sing in Hell's Karaoke bars is "Mambo No. 5", and that she thinks it would be funny to license that song or similar.[25]
Demons do celebrate holidays in Hell.[26]
Instead of celebrating Christmas and expecting Santa Claus, demons eagerly wait for Krampus to visit their homes. Vivziepop has explained that in Hell demons treat Krampus like Santa Claus, viewing him like a good figure, and that like how Krampus is the negative contrast to Santa on Earth, there is a negative contrast to Krampus in Hell as well.[27]
Hell doesn't directly share or use technology from Earth but parallels it with devices of indigenous origin which are introduced alongside modern Sinners upon arrival in Hell.[28] For instance, cellphones in Hell are called "Hellphones" and they play anguished screams in place of conventional phone sounds. However, other technologies presented in both series are decades in advance of technology found on Earth. These include autonomous, sentient machines, advanced cybernetic limbs, and even energy weapons.
According to Viviziepop, Hell years work differently from Earth years.[29]
As shown when the Clock Tower resets for the annual extermination in the Hazbin Hotel pilot, Hell follows Earth's Gregorian Calendar, having 365 days in a year.
However, it is unknown if Hell also follows Earth's leap years.
As shown in Blitzo's calendar seen in "Seeing Stars", it is revealed that Hell has seven-day weeks, which include a Sunday, and as seen in the contents of Stolas' phone in "Western Energy", a Monday.
As shown in the contents of Stolas' phone in "Western Energy", it is revealed that Hell segregates their mornings and nights as "AM" and "PM".
In "Unhappy Campers", after Moxxie and Millie stay on Earth for almost a week, five days, it is revealed that it has also been about a week in Hell as Blitzo yells at Moxxie "It's been like a fucking week", which may imply that Hell and Earth have the same or very similar flow of time as each other.
Contrary to the typical Hell presented in other media, Hell in Hazbin Hotel is a highly elaborate realm that punishes its populace without direct and unending torture as per its religious depictions. Punishment in the Hell of Hazbin Hotel seemingly derives from its continuous state of chaos and violence, with demons and sinners expected to consistently suffer from incidents involving such which they will experience for eternity.[30]
While it is not a mirror image to Heaven,[31] Hell does have a handful of similarities that parallel that of Heaven's. Noteworthy parallels include:
I.M.P being an organization that offers the opposing service of C.H.E.R.U.B.
Despite the purpose both services have, one difference is that C.H.E.R.U.B is bureaucratic (and possibly instituted), while I.M.P is a freelance organization.
Species such as imps have their part of Hell to live in, such as Imp City, a parallel to Heaven's Cherub Towne.
Demons operate by a hierarchy, parallel to Heaven having its hierarchy.[32]
Blitzo hints at the Hell-equivalent phenomenon of an earthquake in the episode "C.H.E.R.U.B", a hellshake or a hellquake. However, it is unknown if this is an actual event or not. And if so, it is also unknown if this phenomenon only happens in selected areas in any of the Rings, since, according to Moxxie, such a thing does not happen or seem to exist.
The rarity of hellshakes might also be a subtle nod to Dante's Inferno, wherein Virgil explains that the ruins and crevices encountered in the 2nd and 7th Circles were all caused by the same tremor that occurred during the Harrowing of Hell.
In "Truth Seekers", Blitzo mentions he dropped out of college, implying that there is a school system.
There are also pictures of Charlie and Seviathan at a prom framed at the Hazbin Hotel, which is specifically an event held at high schools.
In "Apology Tour", it is revealed that hellborn demons can travel to Earth during Halloween. However, it is unclear if this also applies for non-Hellborn demons, such as Sinners.
Hell is able to access and view television programs from both Heaven and Earth.

Deerie is a cherub[1] angel and a minor character who makes her debut in the Helluva Boss episode "C.H.E.R.U.B".

She is the one who informs Cletus, Collin, and Keenie of their banishment from Heaven after they accidentally killed Lyle Lipton, indicating that she is presumably an employee with a higher position unlike the trio.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Compared to her fellow Cherubs, Deerie is a rather tall anthropomorphic fawn who sports very light brown fur with lemon accents, along with brownish-coral hair and ears that are a pastel yellow on the inside with orchid-colored tips.

She also has a dark slate blue-purple nose that could almost match her eyes, which are nearly the same color, albeit slightly brighter. Her eyebrows, eyelashes and hooves are indigo, and she has a pair of pale golden feathered-wings.

There is also a yellowish-white glow around her that matches her halo, and all of her outlines are done in dark purple. Her outfit is that of a set of dark blue overalls over a brighter-colored, long-sleeved shirt with a pink bow hanging from the collar.
Personality

Despite not being given much screen time, it is shown that Deerie, like every other Cherub, is cheerful, optimistic, and angelic. She is also shown to mainly speak in a repetitive speech pattern with apologetic words, although her attitude with banishing the trio from C.H.E.R.U.B did not seem to match up with the words she said, hinting Deerie is indifferent to other people's misery.

Deerie seems to be the leader in the group, since she is the one who states the rules and is seen being the first of the cherubs to arrive.

Deerie peppers her sentences with drawn out "Yeah..." and little "no", even saying the latter multiple times to prove a point.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Flight - Like other cherubs, Deerie has the ability to fly using her wings.
Object materialization - As shown in her debut episode, she is able to summon objects out of thin air, in that case, a pair of reading glasses with a clipboard. Though, it is unknown if this particular feat is unique to her or if it is common among every other cherub.
Banishment - Her debut episode seems to suggest Deerie can banish or exile other cherubs from Heaven, though whether or not she actually has this power herself or if it was done on the behalf of a higher power is currently unknown.

Demons are a supernatural species consisting of dead human sinners[2] and native citizens that inhabit Hell.


ADVERTISEMENT
Description

Demons are a catch-all term for any entity that resides in Hell. Demons can range from unique and sapient species, such as imps or succubi and non-sapient fauna species, to more disparate and non-singular groups, such as Sinners, which represent less of a unique species and more of a disparate collection of incompatible mixtures of different entities. Demons come in all shapes and sizes.

Their physical forms typically have characteristics associated with the human body, except for having human ears and sometimes a lack of a nose.
Culture

Demon society follows cultural lines that are similar to those of humanity in some regards. There are laws that are upheld, facilities that provide goods and services (shops, news stations, bars, etc.), and emergency services such as fire departments.

Technological developments in Hell appear to mirror those on Earth, albeit with a twisted and demonic influence on the design outcome. However, some of Hell's technological developments, specifically weapons technology, have also been influenced and inspired by angelic technology to some unknown degree,[3] which changed the face of Hell combat and led to the development of "blessing" Hell weapons (such as the Carmine-Crafted Blessing-Tipped Rifle used in "The Harvest Moon Festival" and the Blessed Rope used in "Western Energy"), similar to Exorcist weaponry, which can kill even Demon Royalty.

While demon society is very diverse, it can be somewhat divided into two distinct groups in Hell - Sinners and Hellborns. There are also Fallen Angels in Hell, however, Lucifer Morningstar is the only known Fallen Angel.

Most demons also have a somewhat questionable moral compass.

Hell has seven rings, however for reasons or methods unknown, sinners are unable to leave the Pride Ring, and thus are entirely present only in that ring.[4] Hellborn, which applies to all demon species born in Hell, can be found in all seven rings of Hell and can freely travel across any and all of the rings. Charlie and Lucifer are also able to travel the rings of Hell as well.[5]

As revealed in "Overture" by Lute, in regards to the annual Extermination by Heaven to cull Hell's overpopulation, Hellborn demons have been pardoned from the massacre as per the negotiation with Lucifer Morningstar, only allowing Sinners to be targeted and killed by the Exorcists.

As Hellborn demons were never human, nor did they ever live on Earth, they have no experience of humanity or the human world. In spite of this, Hellborns make ready usage of human inspired/derived technology and cultural norms.
Hierarchy

Demons of Hell are governed by a crude form of hierarchy,[6][7] in which one's position in the hierarchy is determined purely by the strength of the individual, and it is dominated by Lucifer, a Fallen Angel, above all other demons (even the likes of Satan and Beelzebub).[8] This hierarchy is roughly divided into tiers; going top-to-bottom, it is as follows:[9]

Lucifer - The King of Hell and the Sin of Pride
Charlie - The Princess of Hell, heir apparent to Hell's throne
The Seven Deadly Sins - Demons who embody one of the seven deadly sins
The Ars Goetia - Hellborn Demons with royal status, including Prince Stolas[10]
Overlords - Demons who wield considerable power
Sinners - Immortal Demons who were once humans on Earth, having sinned were damned to Hell
Hellborn demons - Succubi, Incubi, and other species of demons native to Hell
Imps and Hellhounds - The bottom of Hell's society
The existence of the tiers demonstrate exceptions to the hierarchy system. The first being that a demon's status is treated variably. For instance, Charlie, despite being the second-highest-ranking demon, is not respected by the populace due to their spiteful climate, and her unwillingness to use any of her strength against them. Rather, respect is dependent on the power and intimidation of one's character, like in Lucifer's case.[11]

In this hierarchy, Imps and Hellhounds as the lowest ranked are generally expected to do jobs in service to the higher ranked demons, and in the case of imps are sometimes viewed as "unemployed rabble". It is generally frowned upon for nobility and royalty to sleep with an imp, while some imps, like Striker, view Blitzo and Fizzarolli as embarrassments to imp-kind for having relations with "blue-bloods", such as Stolas and Asmodeus. Due to their low ranking, Hellhounds have to wait five years to get their Hellbies shot which should be done annually.

Sinners are unique in that they can elevate their status by accumulating powers, which they receive by making deals, soul dealing, or even taking it by force.[7] These beings, colloquially known as Overlords, could theoretically rival higher-ranking Hellborn demons or even royalty of Hell, although the royalty would still be considered above them.[12] Overlords typically obtain or enhance their powers by making deals with other demons, as well as dominating them in battle and taking in their dark energy.[13]

While there has never been mention of demons practicing any form of spiritualism or religion, many characters have been seen cursing by Satan's name in lieu of God, which is later confirmed in a stream by Vivienne Medrano that imps view Satan as a deity-like figure,[14] implying there are some sort of belief systems or revering attitudes in Hell, at least with Satan.

Additionally, Vivziepop has mentioned that in Hell demons treat Krampus like Santa Claus, viewing him like a good figure, and eagerly await Krampus' arrival. She also mentioned that like how Krampus is the negative contrast to Santa on Earth, there is a negative contrast to Krampus in Hell as well.[15]

Holidays that demons celebrate include Halloween, where Hellborns are able to travel to Earth, and Sinsmas.

Language

Demons are known to possess their own languages, similar to how humanity has their own languages, as revealed when Charlie is stated to be fluent in every demon language she has learned while growing up. However, it has been explained that like other English-made media set in other countries where characters shouldn't be speaking in English as much as they do, the demons speak in English because it is the language of the show, and that their speaking in the Hell language goes without saying.[16] Despite this, demons seemingly do speak or can speak a form of English, which has been referred to as "Satan's plain English",[17] and humans have been capable of understanding and conversing with demons and vice versa with no apparent difficulty.

The only other non-English languages that demons have communicated in either shows, so far, has been Spanish by Valentino, Carmilla Carmine, and Vassago, and broken Italian by Fizzarolli.

Cultural Relations

Some Angels, such as the cherubs and exorcists, view themselves as holier and more worthy of existence than Demons under the presumption that all Demons -Sinner or Hellborn- are unholy and incapable of goodness.

ADVERTISEMENT

Biology

Appearance

Demons tend to have an overarching theme to their design, typically Hellborn species have very consistent appearances and biological designs according to their species, whereas Sinners can have extremely diverse appearances,[18] capable of looking like anything.[2] Sinners can resemble animals (some more so than others), objects (such as Vox appearing as a television, some gun-esque demons, or even inanimate objects such as couches), humanoid, and more, appearing in a wide array of colors, appearances, sizes, and structures based on what creature their character is based on. According to Vivziepop, hellborn demons appear more monstrous and non-human, whereas demons that appear more humanoid-looking, such as Lucifer and Charlie, are actually quite rare.[2]

As some Sinners can manifest in non-biological forms, such as televisions, furniture, and akin, it is possible that some form of magic can allow these Sinners to function in spite of the lack of a biologically functional body. Hellborns are born with fully functional biological bodies and internal anatomy.

Some demons, particularly Sinners and higher ranking Hellborns, are able to alter parts of themselves at will, such as gaining an extra or new set of appendages such as extra pairs of eyes, horns, limbs, or simply can enhance parts of their default form's body parts, such as the rest of Charlie's teeth becoming pointed fangs. This is referred to as a "full demon" form for sinners and certain Hellborn, and usually appears during periods of intense anger or other emotions.

Abilities

Most, if not all, demons share the following traits:

Demon transformation - Some demons have demonstrated the ability to transform into larger, stronger, and more demonic alternate forms. Numerous characters have been shown capable of this, some being Charlie, Helsa, Katie, Alastor, Stolas, Beelzebub, Mammon, Asmodeus and Verosika and her crew. According to artist Faustisse, nearly all demons can transform when enraged or when in combat.[note 1]
Immortality - Demons, at least for Sinners and Hellborn royalty, do not die of old age and most of the other natural causes that kill humans. Sinners can be infected by Hell's own diseases and the like, making them more miserable, though they can't die from those illnesses.[19] It has yet to be shown how the Sinner recovers; however, "Radio Killed the Video Star" has Velvette imply that, if a Sinner is completely dismembered, even by another Sinner as powerful as an Overlord, they may slowly "pull themselves back together" after some time. However, Sinners can be permanently killed once they are hit with any Angelic Weapons.[20][21] This trait appears to be exclusive to certain demon types, since Imps are capable of dying and aging naturally.
Human disguise - As revealed in "Spring Broken", certain demons are able to shapeshift their appearance into a human lookalike in order to infiltrate the living world. This ability is not perfect, as some demonic characteristics can still be identified, such as eye color or ear shapes. Some human disguise transformations may rely on items such as an Asmodean Crystal or a spell from a grimoire.
Ocular illumination - Most demons, regardless of species, have their eyes glow in the dark passively. Some also have the ability to make their eyes glow in a non dark environment.
Unique abilities - Demons have a wide range of abilities, the types of which are occasionally attributed to certain Hellborn species, such as the succubi's ability to manipulate hormones. Some Hellborn species may even share the same abilities. For Sinners, they possess abilities that vary for every individual, depending on their demon form.
Flight - Certain demons, such as Succubi and some imps, possess wings that allow for flight. Some Sinners, such as Husk, are capable of flight due to their sinner forms having wings.
Demon magic - Some demons are able to do magic and cast spells, such as Charlie Morningstar, Lucifer Morningstar, and Octavia. However, some require special grimoires in order to do so, such as with Loona.
Soul manipulation - Sinners who own souls can control those souls, typically expressed via ethereal chains.
Mortality

All demon species are vulnerable to physical trauma, however, certain groups are immune to death by conventional means. Imps, and several other non-royal Hellborn species, can be killed by conventional weapons and means, in addition to angelic weaponry, although this has yet to be confirmed to be the case for all non-royalty Hellborn. Sinners, and Hellborns who are part of the "Demon Royalty" such as Stolas, can only be killed by angelic weapons, typically wielded by Exorcists.[20] In the case of Sir Pentious in "The Show Must Go On", Adam vaporized him with angelic light, implying that a demon, or more precisely a Sinner, can be killed with angelic magic, however, it is unknown if it can permanently kill any demon like an angelic weapon can since Sir Pentious ascended into Heaven as a redeemed soul.

For Sinners, when hit by an Exorcist's weapon, it results in the "final death" of the demon,[20] and the demon's body is "killed off", while the remaining dark energy in the soul is left to wander into inanimate objects in its surroundings, which purportedly explains why some things such as regular furniture have functioning eyes.[22]

Lifespan

It is suggested that some demons may not be biologically immortal,[note 2] suggesting that they can still die from certain causes, such as old age. Sinners stop aging when they arrive in Hell (ex - Alastor dying in his 30s, he will remain 30 years old for the rest of eternity in Hell). As for Hellborn demons, they are proven to age, denoted in "hell years".[23] However, the rate and overall longevity is unknown. In the case of demonic royalty, such as Charlie, it is known that they are biologically immortal and can live for a long period of time until an angelic weapon-based death, as seen in the case with Stolas, who is immortal but vulnerable to a death caused by an angelic weapon.

Like humans, Hellborn demons are considered legal adults once they become 18.

Demons are able to consume food and similar sustenance, suggesting they need the intake in order to survive, which is supported by the Wrath Ring's essential role in food provision. It is unknown if Sinners also require food to survive, although many do consume food, as shown by Angel Dust and Alastor.

Reproduction

Vivziepop has stated that Sinners cannot reproduce as part of their punishment, but Hellborn demons such as Charlie, Imps, and the Von Eldritch family can reproduce, however for the Sins she only said they "maybe can", except Lucifer who can and already has a child.[24] In the case of Charlie, her birth is yet to be explained as Lucifer is a Fallen Angel in a relationship with Lilith, an unspecified demon type despite being originally human, similar to how Sinners used to be human.

Hellborn species are capable of cross-species breeding and can produce hybridized offspring. Striker, a cross between an Imp and another unknown Hellborn species, was the first known depiction of hybrids in the series.[25] The method of inheritance and genetics, in addition to whether hybrid offspring are still viable, is unknown.

―Emberlynn, to Blitzo, after she arrived in Hell
Emberlynn Pinkle is a sinner demon and a minor character in Helluva Boss who made her debut in the short "Mission: Weeaboo-boo".

Appearance

Human

When she was human, Emberlynn was a short, chubby and pale-skinned young woman who sported a "quirky-goth" type aesthetic. She had black eyes (brown in few scenes) with thick eyelashes, a piercing on her left eyebrow, and pink freckles on her cheeks.

She had wavy and shoulder-length hair that was dyed in an ombre of light turquoise and pink with black roots, indicating that it was her natural hair color. She also had makeup which consists of light pink eyeshadow, and black lipstick and nail polish.

For clothing, Emberlynn wore an alternative/gothic style black sweatshirt with a pink hood, drawstrings and accents, and a pink-and-black plaid skirt. She also wore black over-the-knee stockings with pink toes and heels, along with cuffs being decorated with cat faces.

She accessorized with a pastel and gold pendant, with the wings and pentacle being outlined with gold, that inexplicably protected her from actual demons.

Sinner

As a sinner demon, Emberlynn retains her body shape and aesthetic, but now she takes the appearance of a light blue-furred cat-like demon with cat ears, a small hot-pink nose, and a light pink tail with the tip being the same color as her fur.

She now sports more devilish qualities, such as a pair of small black horns atop of her head, small dragon-like wings, and a mouth with sharp teeth inside. Her hair is now colored in three shades of pink, and her eyes have cyan irises with hot-pink sclera and slit pupils, with eyelids colored in a darker shade of her fur, and an extra third eye on her forehead with an extra eyebrow.

Her clothing remains the same, but with the exception of a pink dripping paw design on the center of her sweatshirt, and the cuffs of her stockings now being decorated with demon-like faces.

Personality

Emberlynn is shown to be a quirky, obsessive stereotypical otaku goth girl with a love for Japanese culture and a monster fetish, to such an extent that her room is covered with monster-lover memorabilia from wall to wall. As shown, Emberlynn possesses a very detached perception of reality and likely had difficulty separating it from her hyperactive imagination.

She has delusions and a lack of social skills, as shown where she had showcased multiple instances of not noticing social cues of others nor reading the mood of her surroundings. She has extreme delusions of grandeur, as shown where her immediate belief upon her room being broken into by a demon attempting to kill her was that he chose her to be his lover, acting dramatic and flirtatious from this perception.

She is further showcased to have immediately created an entire narrative about Blitzo and his life from whatever tidbits of information she got from him and has shown to fully believe it as the "truth". After Blitzo cursed using Satan's name, Emberlynn immediately came up with a delusional romantic narrative about him, Blitzo and Blitzo's "wife". Further, she believed she was "destined" to be with Blitzo, or that Satan himself wanted her as a bride alongside Blitzo, and allowed herself to be killed in order to be sent to the afterlife so she and Blitzo could be together forever. All her behavior implying that she fully and completely believed her delusions to be real.

Due to her delusional mindset, she was likewise ignorant of Blitzo's obvious discomfort to her advances, and became very persistent in getting to him to achieve her fantasized dream. Likewise, even when Blitzo attempted to point out the truth of why he was there and the reality that he wasn't there to whisk her away as his lover, Emberlynn was shown to either willfully ignore his words and twist it around to fit into her narrative, likewise ignoring any form of common sense, or her delusions are severe enough that her perception is otherwise altering it to fit into what she wants subconsciously.

Emberlynn has also shown to be a surprisingly talented writer, having come up with and written a several page story about her romantic fantasy about herself, Blitzo and Satan in a matter of seconds after coming up with her romantic-sexual narrative about Blitzo.

Upon arriving in Hell, Emberlynn immediately stalks Blitzo and finds him, loudly professing her love for him from the street outside I.M.P Headquarters.
Abilities'

Immortality - As a Sinner, Emberlynn is biologically immortal, being unable to die from illnesses and unable to age, remaining the same age as when she died, thus can not die of old age and other natural causes. She also cannot die from any kind of damage to the body, and will recover from any injury, however, she can only be permanently killed with angelic weaponry.
Skillset

Speed writing - Emberlynn is able to write multiple paragraphs of a story in under four seconds, with complete coherency, dialogue, and actions.
Possessions

Akuma no Otto pendant glowing
Akuma no Otto Pendant
Akuma no Otto pendant (formerly) - A necklace merchandise from Emberlynn's favorite anime series that she owned and wore as a human. As shown, the pendant is somehow able to protect its wearer from being touched by demons or harmed by their weapons via covering the wearer in a golden barrier.
History

Past

As a human, Emberlynn was a young gothic college student living in her parents' house in the suburbs. Some time seven years ago, she shipped characters "Scrimbleson" and "Shawnathan" together, which earned her the ire of an unnamed client who years later paid to have her assassinated by I.M.P, justifying that the ship is basically incest.

Helluva Shorts

"Mission: Weeaboo-boo"

Blitzo broke into her room in order to assassinate her, however, her pendant protected her from the demon. Emberlynn, after realizing Blitzo is a demon, begins to lust after him, much to his annoyance. After she acts out the current situation like a fanfiction, Blitzo gets her to remove her necklace with his knife in order to "meet him on the other side". He then stabs her dead as she moans sexually, much to Blitzo's disgust as he promptly leaves.

After her death, she became a Sinner in Hell, and upon noticing an I.M.P billboard, she found where Blitzo worked and continue to harass him via stalking him.

Relationships

Her parents

Despite being in her 20s and in college, she continues living with her parents. It is unknown what her relationship with them is, but the couple seem to be tired and driven crazy by her obsessions (like hentai) enough for her mother to question why Emberlynn won't move out. Despite this, they still seem to care about her, given as how they haven't kicked her out yet, and try not to mind her "hen-tay" hobbies too much when they mistake the sounds of Blitzo breaking in her room for it.

Blitzo

Upon meeting Blitzo, Emberlynn's immediate assumption is that the assassin is here to seduce her and play into her teratophiliac fantasies, even though this is obviously not the case. Eventually, Emberlynn allows herself to be killed by Blitzo so that he can "Take [her] mortal soul to Hell so that [they] can be together forever!". It is heavily unrequited, with Blitzo unceremoniously killing her via stabbing and wanting to put the mission behind him, however, Emberlynn finds him in Hell after becoming a sinner, and loudly professes her love. Blitzo does not respond, and crouches out of sight of the window to I.M.P.

Gallery

Emberlynn Pinkle/Gallery
Trivia

She shares her voice actor, Monica Franco, with Vaggie in the Hazbin Hotel pilot, Counselor Jimmy, her mother and several other background characters.
Based on her interests and behavior regarding human-monster romance, Emberlynn may possess teratophilia, also known as the sexual attraction to monsters.
Despite being listed as "Emberlynn" in the I.M.P mission report, episode subtitles, and merchandise, the credits of "Mission: Weeaboo-boo" and a Tweet from Monica Franco,[1] misspell the name as "Emberlyn".
Her literary pseudonym, "Emberlynn Light'ness Demoanya Pinkle", may be a parody of the name "Ebony Dark'ness Dementia Raven Way" from the infamous Harry Potter fan fiction, My Immortal.
Like Burnie Burnz, Emberlynn seems to represent the negative and disturbing aspects of fandoms. In her case, Emberlynn seems to represent obsessive fans who have trouble separating fiction from reality.
She has a knock-off plushie of Charlie Morningstar shown in her room.
She may be a masochist or unable to feel pain. Although she does moan while getting stabbed by Blitzo, she stops and makes a dramatic face, as if she were acting and/or pretending to like/feel the pain inflicted onto her.
Her behavior could just be due to her delusions of grandeur and her interpreting Blitzo's murder of her as an extreme and ultimate gesture of love between a human and a demon, due to her thinking that he wants to be together with her forever in Hell.

"♪ I have taken shit, been crushed under your heel. I have suffered for profit and suckered for fame, made a fortune you could steal. I've had enough, I've hit the wall. I'm tired of taking your calls, it ends today. Now, there's just one last thing to say...fuck you! ♪"
―Fizzarolli, to his former boss
Fizzarolli is a famous performer and entertainer, as well as a former antagonist turned supporting character in Helluva Boss who made his debut in "Ozzie's".

A former clown at Cash Buckzo's circus and childhood best friend of Blitzo, Fizzarolli is well-known across the rings, boasting a comedy career working for several demons, including two of the Seven Deadly Sins; his former boss Mammon, and business partner and boyfriend Asmodeus.[5]

As of "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", Fizzarolli no longer works as Mammon's brand figure, and is openly in a relationship with Asmodeus.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Current

Fizzarolli is a tall and slim imp with a jester getup. His eyes have lime sclera and pinkish-red irises, his teeth are neon blue, and he has an imp tail with black stripes, however the stripe in the middle is white from "Oops" onward and in Blitzo's hallucination in "Truth Seekers". His cybernetic arms and legs are retractable, able to extend and bend far more than normal jointed limbs could and in "Oops" is shown to have a light blue circle on each shoulder and light blue spots on his knuckles.

The majority of Fizzarolli's head is covered in a huge burn scar, with the only parts unaffected being the tip of his mouth resembling a clown nose, and a small part of the back of his head, which show his original red skin. His face also has black dots at the ends of his mouth, and he has a forked tongue that has a couple of black stripes on it as well. He is shown in "Oops" to have a small purple heart tattoo on the back of his neck. As seen in flashbacks and mentioned by Fizzarolli himself, he used to have exceptionally large horns for an imp. However, these horns were damaged and then cauterized.

He wears a bright red and blue jester cap with bells, a white ruff, and a black collar with bells located below it. His jester hat's stripe patterns resemble those of his horns' as a child, being asymmetrical from both sides. The front side of his outfit is bright red with yellow trim at the bottom with yellow hearts, while the back is bright blue with white trim at the bottom and black hearts.

He wears white and purple striped pants along with white and purple striped sleeves with bright red cuffs and yellow trim edging, and yellow balls on his shoulders with light red hearts. He also wears black, heeled shoes with yellow hearts on the front, black gloves with red spots on the knuckles, and yellow cuffs.

Young

As a child, it is shown that Fizzarolli had the heart-skull marking on his forehead like the rest of the associated circus performers. He also used to have red irises, biological arms and legs, and a pair of large asymmetrically striped black-and-white horns.

His tail maintains its identical appearance to what he possesses as an adult, minus the white area in the middle.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Current

Fizzarolli is a theatrical demon, with a fast-talking demeanor and a crude sense of humor. Extremely vulgar in nature, he constantly makes sexual jokes and puns, to the degree he pairs up with Asmodeus in openly condescending sentimental relationships and offering lewd suggestions. He was shown to be especially condescending towards Blitzo, with whom he has a bad history with, which stems from an accident that happened at Cash Buckzo's circus fifteen years prior to "Oops", however Fizzarolli found it in him to forgive Blitzo after the latter rescued him from Crimson, his mafia and Striker.

Early in the series, Fizzarolli seemed to embody Blitzo's comments about being an overrated sellout clown, given how he did not seem to mind having his image exploited by Mammon's corporate marketing because it made him popular and famous for being a Sin's name-brand figure. This included having no issue with his likeness being marketed for a line of sex toys, despite how it secretly creeped him out. He also dislikes the creepy fans who enjoy the Robo Fizz sex toys, even secretly ordering the staff at Ozzie's to keep a creepy fan far away from him after they proclaimed they owned four.

Despite his normal jovial nature Fizzarolli suffers from extreme self-worth and self-image issues, the latter of which mostly originating from the severe injuries he received from a circus fire that he was involved in when he was younger. Because of this, he feels like he needs to do whatever Mammon tells him to do, as he feels he must repay the man for all the fame and success being his brand figure has brought, despite how horribly he is treated. He also believes unless he keeps propitiating the fame and admiration he will be nothing and will lose Asmodeus, as he's only ever seen him as he claims it "his best", and believes he is barely worthy of working with a king of sin because of his disfigurement.

Young

During his childhood, Fizzarolli possessed an energetic and spirited attitude. However, he was very meek. He had great aptitude for his work as a circus performer, able to quickly win the audience with his craft and charm.

He is shown to have been a close childhood friend to Blitzo, with the two enjoying a strong, positive relationship in their free time together as seen during their down time backstage at the circus and in photos on Blitzo's phone.

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Charisma - As both an adult and child, Fizzarolli is a highly charismatic individual. He is capable of entertaining a large crowd of individuals while also compensating for the poor performances of other individuals during an entertainment event. Fizzarolli is even able to charm the members of Crimson's mafia, preventing them from inciting further violence and emotionally captivating several of them with an entirely improvised performance.
Cybernetic prosthetic limbs - As an adult, Fizzarolli possesses a set of enhanced arms and legs. With the arms having an attached cybernetic pair of hands and fingers, these limbs are capable of rapid extension and retraction over incredibly long distances. Despite their flexibility, Fizzarolli isn't good at using these limbs in combat, but he can use them to effectively evade harm by contorting his body and bouncing away in a spring-like fashion. Despite not being good at combat, he was able to unleash a punch at Striker in a spring-like manner.
Skillset

Musical talent - Fizzarolli is a highly proficient singer. This makes him proficient at distracting people, allowing allies to sneak past them or steal something from the target. Furthermore, Fizz has the ability to simultaneously produce and interpret, within or without harmonic or rhythmic parameters, melodies, rhythms or vocalizations from different genres, such as polka, heavy metal, and even Italian opera.
Rollerskating - In "Oops", he was seen roller skating with his pet Queives.
Forklift proficiency - In "The Full Moon", Fizzarolli is seen operating a forklift.
Juggling - He has shown some competent juggling skills in "Oops."
Balloon animal-making - Fizzarolli can make balloon animals quickly and easily, shown when he made a perfect balloon horse in "The Circus".
Distraction tactics - As mentioned in "Oops", when he and Blitzo were young Fizzarolli would distract Cash Buckzo so that Blitzo could steal his booze. In the same episode, Fizzarolli successfully distracts Crimson, Striker, and several of Crimson's mafia members while Blitzo was opening a window in the warehouse. His only limits to this are how long he needs to make a distraction and how to keep it up.
Sign language - In "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", Fizzarolli is shown communicating in sign language to talk to a young deaf imp.
ADVERTISEMENT

Gallery

Fizzarolli/Gallery
Trivia

According to Vivziepop the name "Fizzarolli" was initially supposed to be a placeholder name.[6]
Fizzarolli, alongside his robotic duplicate Robo Fizz, was first announced during a BLM Charity Stream on June 9, 2020.[5]
According to Vivziepop, the voice actor for the character is a Broadway actor and his work influenced the design.[7] This was revealed to be Alex Brightman, known for his role as the titular character of Beetlejuice in Broadway.
Brightman also uses a similar voice for both Beetlejuice and Fizzarolli as well as Robo Fizz.
While being based on Fizzarolli, Robo Fizz has significant differences in design, the most notable being his outfit, pupilless eyes, and lack of a tail.
Interestingly, Fizzarolli's arms and legs are mechanically jointed and resemble those of Robo Fizz, even being able to extend while making the same electronic sounds as he does. It is confirmed in the episode "Oops" that Fizzarolli's current limbs are bionic prosthetics which replaced his original limbs that were severely damaged due to fire.
In the episode "The Circus", young Blitzo's tragic story for his balloon animal, Worm Horse, could be an allusion to Fizzarolli's current state.
Fizzarolli is the first, and so far, only imp shown to have had asymmetrical stripe patterns on his horns.
Fizzarolli is stated to have the most outfits compared to other characters in Helluva Boss, and although most of them haven't been revealed, Vivienne Medrano says that he has "like fucking 800" of them.[8]
Fizzarolli is mentioned to not be a good cook according to Asmodeus in "Oops".
It is also revealed that there is a heart on the back of Fizzarolli's neck when he is in his pajamas, however, it is unclear whether it is a birthmark or a tattoo.
While Fizzarolli sings in Italian in the song Look At This!, according to Sam Haft, despite having "the most Italian name in Hell", Fizzarolli does not speak Italian.[9]
According to Sam Haft, the more Fizzarolli did in the song, the more miserable he was and Fizzarolli was running out of ideas, leading to maybe speaking fake Italian works. Haft also explains that he channeled "having to improvise when you have no brain cells left because you've already improvised everything up until that point".[10]
According to Sam Haft, Fizzarolli is a performer, not a fighter.[10] This was later stated by Fizzarolli himself in "Oops".
Fizzarolli's phone case reading out "Queen Clussy" is a reference to a meme format wherein people combine the word "pussy" with a defining characteristic or trait, in this case "clussy" would be a combination of the words "clown" and "pussy".
Fizzarolli shares his voice actor, Alex Brightman, with his robotic counterpart, as well as Adam and Sir Pentious from the Hazbin Hotel main series.
Development

When asked about how the voice for Fizzarolli was decided on, Alex Brightman explained that Vivziepop sent him an email saying that she saw Beetlejuice and loved it, and asked if he could take a look at a character for Helluva Boss and if he could do that exact same Beetlejuice voice for the character. Alex added that they talked about it and they decided to make it a little higher and a little more childish.[11]

―Glitz and Glam, boasting about their talent
Glitz and Glam are twin demons who made their debut in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)".

They are contestants and Fizzarolli's former competition to be Mammon's new brand figure.

Appearance

Glitz and Glam are tall, slim and faded daphne blue-skinned demons with fish-like features - such as head fins similar to a that of a lionfish, and a pair of large, retractable fin-like wings on their back. They also have a pair of black-ended horns on top of their heads.

Both sisters sport eyes with cyan-colored irises, deep teal sclera, slit pupils, large extravagant eyelashes protruding from them, lighter-colored upper eyelids and black marks across them. They also have lengthy, extravagant and fin-like hair which are colored in multiple shades of teal and cyan, which are styled to resemble high ponytails with long bangs.

Their mouths have black lips with a black spot at each end, and sharp teeth inside.
Glitz

Glitz's bangs are styled in a spiky, mohawk-like way,[1] colored in a bright teal with darker-colored edges and deep teal green stripes. Meanwhile, her ponytail is colored a bright teal with a darker-colored stripe running across it, along with three deep teal green spots and dark navy-colored edges, as well as the interior colored in a shade of dark teal.

Her eyes have large bright teal fins with darker-colored edges, which acts as her eyelashes.

Glitz wears both a dark navy choker and a dark navy crop-top, with the top itself sporting a cyan pom-pom on the front and long sleeves; her left sleeve having both cyan trim and three cyan diamonds on it.

Her high-waisted miniskirt is seafoam-and-dark teal in a triangle-like pattern, while her thigh-high tights are a dark navy color with a cyan pom-pom on each foot, as well as an asymmetrical-like pattern; the right having three cyan diamonds while the left has a seafoam-colored stripe. She accessorizes with fingerless gloves which are the same color as her top, choker and tights.

Glam

Glam's bangs are styled in a long, straight way,[1] colored in a bright teal with a slight darker-colored stripe, along with both three dark navy-colored spots and a dark navy blue interior. Meanwhile, her ponytail is colored in a dark navy with bright teal edges and two cyan star-sparkles, as well as the interior colored in a shade of dark teal.

Her eyes have lengthy and spiky eyelashes which are entirely black, with small dots adorning each end.

Glam wears a high-collared deep teal crop-top that sports an upside-down heart-shaped cutout and long, dark navy-colored sleeves; her right sleeve having three cyan circles while her left is detached from the top.

Around her waist is a seafoam-colored miniskirt which resembles a jester's collar with multiple triangular appendages and a ball on each end, worn over a set of dark navy-colored tights which sported a cyan pom-pom on each foot, as well as an asymmetrical-like pattern; the right leg having a seafoam stripe while the left leg has three cyan diamonds. She accessorizes with a set of bright teal gloves on her hands; the right over her sleeve while the left is under her sleeve.

Personalities

Glitz and Glam are sassy, prideful and egotistic, as seen when they talk down to Fizzarolli in their debut episode. They believe themselves to be wholly superior to him and presumably the other contestants in the Clown Pageant.

They appeared to have a typical sibling relationship towards each other, not afraid to throw insults at each other while functioning perfectly as a team during their acts and also often seen holding hands and smiling at each other. This suggested that, in spite of not always getting along, the sisters are still very much close.

There seems to be a noticeable difference in their personalities, with Glitz being the more energetic and excitable twin, as she is often seen laughing and smiling widely, and Glam is the more measured and stoic twin, as she is seen unamused or annoyed with a frown on her face. Additionally, Glitz seems more willing to use her sex appeal, having no problem with flashing the crowd during their song.
Abilities

Flight - Both Glitz and Glam have retractable wings that allow them to fly.
Pyrokinesis - The twins have shown the ability to project fire around themselves.
Fire resistance - They have both shown that they can set themselves on fire without injury or even minor burns.
Hydrokinesis - They may have the ability to manipulate water as shown when they levitated using it during their song.
Bioluminescence - Glitz and Glam are both able to make their hair and their eyes glow. There seems to be spots on their hair that are able to glow bright blue.
Skillset

Acrobatics - They are shown to be talented with acrobatics, as shown when they are on a tight rope.
Juggling - Glitz and Glam are shown being able to juggle, while on a tight rope, upside-down, and using their feet.
Balloon animal-making - They make balloon animals quickly and easily, as shown when they made a big balloon crown.
Musical talent - Glitz and Glam are shown to have talent for singing, such as when they performed their song during the finals of Mammon's annual clown pageant.
Rapping - Glitz is capable of rapping, as seen during her solo during "Klown Bitch".
Synchronization - The twins have shown to be able to move in synchronization, which they can do effortlessly.
History

Helluva Boss Season 2

"MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)"

Glitz and Glam went to the Greed Ring to participate in Mammon's Clown Pageant. They openly ridiculed Fizzarolli upon first meeting him, though soon began arguing with each other before Blitzo interrupted them, criticizing their mean girl act.

During the first round, the Glam sisters put on an amazing performance that even made Mammon openly admit he reflected on his earlier statements of women not being funny. They, along with fellow finalist Fizzarolli, went to a meet and greet with the fans before the final round. After Fizzarolli's encounter with a deranged fan, Glitz and Glam taunted the clown again. Mammon had them perform first, and they put on another impressive show, leading to further Fizzarolli's already progressing anxiety attack.

Glitz and Glam watched Fizzarolli's performance and subsequent resignation, flipping the middle finger at him under a spotlight when he calls them bitches. After Mammon's explosion, Glitz and Glam found themselves thrown to the ground, and when wondering if they had won the competition, they smiled at each other until a pillar toppled on top of the two performers.

Relationships

Family

Themselves

Glitz and Glam are twin sisters whose specialty is synchronization, as they are sometimes speaking in unison, or finishing each other's sentences, making them able to do their mirroring-act for their performances. During their debut episode, they are seen throwing insults at each other, but they claimed that they don't let their personal feelings get in the way of their act.

Ultimately, they also claimed that they don't need to keep up with the mirroring when off-stage, proving their professional demeanor as performers.

Others

Blitzo

After Blitzo meets them, he developed a disliking to them, telling Fizzarolli to "pile drive" them at the clown pageant.

Fizzarolli

When Fizzarolli tries to be civil with the sisters, they openly mock him and wanted to take his title.

Mammon

They wanted to be Mammon's new brand figure, during a song, they praised him and selling themselves out by saying he can sell their bodies. After Fizzarolli quits, it is unknown if they became his new brand figure.

Gallery

Glitz and Glam/Gallery
Trivia

Glitz and Glam's names are based on the phrase "glitz and glamour".
Their designs might be inspired by more modern circus performances like those seen in Cirque du Soleil.
Their facial expressions appear to be inspired by the comedy and tragedy masks of theater.
They share their speaking voice actor with Katie Killjoy in the Hazbin Hotel pilot.
Monica Franco spent three hours separating colors so Julia V. Bebisheva could make Glitz's breasts glow when she lifted her top during the twins' song.[2]
According to Julia V. Bebisheva, Monica Franco was calling the twins Glamantha and Glitzandra for bad behavior.[3]
According to Sam Miller, when she asked Cécilia Goncalves to create an alternate glowy palette for Glitz and Glam during Klown Bitch, Cécilia gave her a lineup of options that were so good that she designed the song to use as many as possible.[4]
In a tweet, Sam Haft explained that the lyrics of Klown Bitch are not about being a "clown", instead Glitz and Glam are singing about wanting to participate in Mammon's financial and sexual exploitation,[5] and the song is actually about greed and exploitation, with the twins trying to demonstrate that they should win because they can better manipulate the masses out of their money.[6]
In an Instagram highlights by Vivziepop, it was confirmed that Glitz and Glam will return

Hellhounds, also known simply as Hounds, are a sapient species of Demons native to Hell.[1] They share the lowest ranking in Hell's hierarchy alongside Imps.


ADVERTISEMENT
Description

Hellhounds are in the lowest-ranking tier of Hell's hierarchy system, along with Imps.[2] Because of this, the majority have a servitude role and used primarily for labor or work to the point that their service is advertised by businesses.[3] They resemble anthropomorphic canines such as domestic Earth dogs and wolves. It's also implied Hellhounds can be pets for other demons.

Hellhound orphans can be adopted by other demons regardless of species in animal shelter-esque adoption centers as pets, cheap labor, bodyguards, or family. The condition of the center Loona was adopted from was in poor condition, with the orphans being behind bars and not appearing well-cared for. Any orphan not adopted by the age of 18 will "age-out" of the adoption circuit and kicked out as they would legally be considered an adult.
Cultural relations

Due to being low ranked like Imps, and having a natural, animalistic behavior and appearance, they are treated similar to guard dogs and pets. Due to this, Hellhounds have to wait five years for their annual Hellbies shot appointment at St. An's Hospital.

Hellhounds are anthropomorphic demons that resemble canines or canine-like carnivorans, taking after one specific breed or species for their appearance, with some looking like wolves, and others like more traditional domesticated dog breeds, such as Doberman, poodles, and huskies. Hellhounds thus far all share red sclera with white irises, as well as distinguishable ears, tails, and muzzles specific to their breed-inspired type.

Abilities

Human disguise - Some Hellhounds have been shown to be able to don a human appearance on Earth. These disguises typically retain some traits of their true demon forms, in the case of Vortex's his scarred eye is prominently featured.
Ocular illumination - As shown with Loona, hellhounds have the ability to make their eyes glow.
Enhanced senses - Hellhounds appear to have an amazing extrasensory type of smell for tracking a target by sniffing an item that identifies them. Loona, for instance, smelled a hit list of humans for the I.M.P and could identify who their targets were even though it was no more than a list of names. However, their sense of smell can be hindered by air pollutants, such as the case with Loona being unable to sniff out Octavia in Los Angeles due to the polluted air.
Quadrupedalism - As shown by Loona when she reacted with seeing her Hellbies shot, Hellhounds can go from biped to quadruped.
Feral transformation - As shown by Loona in "Sinsmas", Hellhounds can demonstrate the ability to transform into large, quadrupedal demon dog-like creatures, large enough to allow an imp to ride on them.
Behavior

Hellhounds typically behave no more differently than other demons. However, they do possess canine-like qualities such as snarling and showing teeth when angered, ears and tails perking up or going down according to their mood, and reacting like a dog being taken to the vet for a shot, as well as lashing out when cornered.

Mortality

Similarly to Imps, Hellhounds can be killed by non-Angelic Weapons, like gunshots to the head, as seen when Blitzo shot a Hellhound off of Fizzarolli in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)".

According to Blitzo, there is a disease called Hellbies that Hellhounds can catch if they do not get vaccinated annually, but because of the low placement in Hell's hierarchy it takes five years to schedule an appointment at St. An's Hospital. While the full extent of Hellbies is not clear, Blitzo was determined to ensure Loona got her shot no matter what.

ADVERTISEMENT

Trivia

The Hellhound is a folkloric creature tracing back to Greek mythology; described as a species of supernatural canid of the underworld, the Hellhound traditionally features black fur, red eyes, and ghoulish characteristics. They are often assigned to tasks involving the afterlife, such as guarding the entrances to the world of the dead or hunting lost souls. Cerberus, the three-headed guard dog of the god of the underworld, Hades, was considered a hellhound. In post-classical European cultures, they were considered an omen of death.
Hellhounds are one of the few species of demon shown to have visible ears, with the only other exception being certain damned former humans, such as Mrs. Mayberry and Alastor, and a few succubi, featuring pointed ears.
Since the start of season two, Hellhounds have been revealed to come in many different variants in terms of appearance, not just appearing as wolves, but also appearing similar to regular breeds of dogs. Though this would have also been revealed in "Queen Bee", had the episode not been delayed and was released in chronological order.
Doc holding the giant syringe
Hellbies shot
Hellhounds need to be vaccinated against Hellbies, a parody of Rabies, every year.
But, because of how Hellhounds simultaneously rank the lowest in Hell's hierarchy alongside Imps, Blitzo only had the chance to make an appointment for Loona's 5 years after her adoption.
Which could imply why Loona’s was comically large, compared to others in the basket Dr. Somna had.
The dosage for a Hellbies shot is comically large, needing two hands to be able to carry the shot, and the serum is colored neon green.
There is a poster of a Hellhound getting a Hellbies shot, saying "Get Yours Today or else." implying Hellbies could be fatal.
While many Hellhounds seem to be willing to get vaccinated to avoid catching Hellbies, as Dr. Somna had no problem with his previous Hellhound patients, Loona hated getting shots so much she went feral.
After getting vaccinated, Loona had to wear a cone, presumably to prevent any form of scratching or biting on the vaccinated area.
Due to an abundance of Hellhounds in the Gluttony Ring shown in "Queen Bee", it is possible that Hellhounds are native to the Gluttony Ring similarly to how Imps are native to the Wrath Ring.
When Loona calls Vikki a "bitch" in "Queen Bee", everyone reacts in shock and someone said "You can't say that", which may imply it is some type of racial slur.
Coincidentally, the word "bitch" also refers to a female dog in the English dictionary.
It is also revealed that hellhounds say "Oh, my dog" as opposed to the usual expression of "Oh, my god".
There are bone shaped treats for Hellhounds.
As seen in "Mastermind", hellhounds are detained by law enforcement with an additional muzzle.
As seen in "Sinsmas", due to Loona undergoing a secondary transformation into a fully-formed wolf, this may imply that even lowest-ranking hellborns possess a full demon form, much like higher-ranked hellborns, sinners and royal demons do, although it is possible this is a trait unique to her species.
Despite being in the same rank as imps, hellhounds are sometimes owned or adopted by them as pets or personal labor.

entries.content:
NAME

LOCATION

"Humans are full of secret nasties, it's why so many of them end up here."
―Millie describing humans
Humans are a sapient species native to the planet Earth. Deceased human souls make up all of the Sinner Demons of Hell and Earth-born angels of Heaven.

All humans are descendants of Adam.

History

After the creation of the Earth, the angels from Heaven used the dust of Earth and created the first of humanity; Adam and Lilith. The first couple were created to be equal, but Adam demanded full control over Lilith; however, she refused to submit to his will and fled the Garden of Eden. Lilith was found by Lucifer and the couple fell in love.

The two, wishing to share free will with humanity under the assumption they could do remarkable things with it, gifted Adam's new wife, Eve, the Fruit of Knowledge, who gladly accepted. This single act allowed evil to make its way into the Earth and humanity, and with it the creation of Hell and the sinners.
Description

As the primary lifeform on Earth, humans are the only known sapient species to live on Earth, and subsequently the known universe.

Upon death, depending on the actions that the human takes while on Earth, the human's soul receives divine judgement and enters into either Heaven as an Angel or Hell as a Demon. If human souls ascend to Heaven as angels, they enjoy eternal paradise, however, if they are damned to Hell as sinners, they live out their afterlife as post mortem punishment. Due to this, it is a common belief amongst Hells native demons that deceased human souls cannot become ghosts and do not linger on Earth.

Aside from many interpretations of the afterlife, human society as a whole is entirely unaware of the true nature of the afterlife, Heaven and Hell. However, throughout Earth's history, the entities of these realms have travelled to Earth and interacted with humans for various reasons, such as business, ritual, pleasure, or more wide-scale affairs.

Humans are often exploited by demons, such as the Succubi species, who use humans to spread sexual activity, but otherwise remain in the dark about these beings. Some fringe groups, such as D.H.O.R.K.S., claim knowledge of the afterlife and Hell. These groups, however, are typically dismissed by most humans, according to Stolas.

While most humans dismiss the existence of demons and the afterlife, many have beliefs in urban legends on Earth. In "Mission: Chupacabras", there are people who believe in the legend of the Chupacabra, the goat-sucker. In addition, in "Ghostf**kers", humans believe in the concept of ghosts even though they apparently do not exist due to the fact that human souls can only go to either Heaven or Hell and cannot return to or linger on Earth as a "ghost".

Bee, a female human
Bee, a female human
Skool, a male human
Skool, a male human
Mortality

Humans are very susceptible to dying in various ways, including natural causes such as old age or disease, and any large amount of damage to their bodies such as being shot, stabbed, dismembered, asphyxiated, or receiving hard enough blunt force trauma. In addition, large doses of drugs or alcohol can cause death in humans.

Cultural Relations

Demons have mixed views on humanity. For example, Millie says that humans are full of "secret nasties" and it often results to many human souls entering Hell. Angels are willing to interact with living humans, such as the Cherubs who are sent to save humans from death and/or reform them into virtuous people, allowing them a higher chance to enter Heaven as angels.

Trivia

According to Faustisse, the voices of Sinners are changed from the one they had as humans, possibly into "whatever fits proper".[note 1] This detail may be retconned, since this does not seem to be the case with Mrs. Mayberry. Although, her tone is significantly less jovial than her human self's.
In the Helluva Boss episode "Murder Family", Martha and her family seem to temporarily take on certain "demonic" traits such as sharp teeth, red eyes, and slit pupils when in a state of evil derangement; these traits vanish as the situation de-escalates. It is unclear if this was a tendency unique to humans such as them, given that they were worshipers of evil forces, or if these traits are likely meant as visual metaphors, and not literal transformations.
As revealed in "Welcome to Heaven", it is unknown what the requirements are for a human soul to ascend to Heaven.
As deceased souls from Earth appear in Heaven and Hell, Hellborn demons don't believe ghosts exist. Despite this, some demons, such as Blitzo, choose to believe that ghosts do exist.

Imps are a subspecies of Hellborn Demons[1][2] that hold the lowest ranking in Hell's hierarchy alongside Hellhounds.

Description

Typical imp family
A typical imp family
Imps are essentially the "working-class" of Hell's society.[3] They hold the lowest ranking in Hell's hierarchy, alongside Hellhounds, and therefore are among the least respected and most likely to be hired for heavy labor work, or as servants for higher ranking demons.

There is a hotspot in the Pride Ring for imps called Imp City, which appears extremely shabby and rundown, even by Hell's standards.
Cultural relations

Due to their poor status among the demons of Hell's hierarchy, imps do not get along with higher-ranked demons, who possess natural stigma toward them for perceived inferiority. Stella, a Goetic demon, calls imps "peasants", "plebeians", and "poor people", and is openly against the idea of high-ranked demons, more specifically a demon of the Goetia, sleeping or being in a relationship with an imp. Paimon, Stolas' father and another Goetic demon, sees the idea of a high-ranked demon bowing to an imp ridiculous, saying imps should be bowing to them.

In "Western Energy", a fish demon child innocently calls Blitzo a "fire toad" when he was surprised that St. An's Hospital allowed imps in, visibly offending him, and the mother tells her child to wait until they are in the car as "it's not polite to say that to their face". Imps, as a species of demon, can be held in contempt by Angels. The Cherubs in "C.H.E.R.U.B", say that imps are "nothing but dirt that shitty dead people tread on".

In "Ghostf**kers", it is said that imps, or specifically Wrathian imps, are expected to be nothing more than dumb muscle. In addition, imps typically do not manage to work for themselves, and any cases otherwise, such as starting their on business, is considered impressive.

In "Mastermind", Satan mentions that he created the imps to be obedient and dutiful in their role as part of the workforce of Hell and that any imp who attempts to try and rise from that role to "gain the upper hand" by defying higher ranks is considered disgraceful or even a disappointment to their kind.

Imps are designed to look like how the devil is typically portrayed in media, with red skin, horns and an arrow-tipped tail. Sometimes there is black or white stripes or splotches on the tail. All imps have skin in a shade of red and striped horns. Imps have yellow (or lime-green like Fizzarolli) sclerae that glow in the dark with black slitted pupils, and sometimes visible red irises that tend to grow wide when an Imp is angered; some imps have white markings on their skin as well.

Stolas, Stella and Andrealphus

One of the most distinctive traits that tell imps apart is the shape of their horns, which the shape can vary greatly between individuals. Imps themselves also come in a variety of shapes and sizes. The majority of imps are smaller in stature than humans, but imp height varies significantly, ranging from between comparable to an average human, to small enough to fit into a bag.
