Imps exhibit sexual dimorphism of their hair and horns depending on their birth sex: female imps generally have dark hair and black horns with thin white or grey grooves on them, while male imps tend to have white hair with striped black-and-white horns.[4] Although these are predominant traits, there are apparent exceptions, such as a male imp with dark hair that can be seen in the background of the episode "Loo Loo Land". Sallie May, a transgender female imp, has black hair like female imps, however, her horns and parts of her hair remain biologically unaltered. Lin, an older female imp, has greying hair. It can be noted that some Imps naturally lack hair their entire lives. In the case of Cash Buckzo, his kids, and Fizzarolli, they would be considered bald.[note 1] Once an imp's horn(s) breaks, they don't grow back. Imps appear to take a measure of pride in their horns, as Fizzarolli's was once considered larger than Blizto's during their youth in the circus, which was considered a sore spot for the former. Following the accident that resulted in his grevious injuries and broke his horns, Fizzarolli covers them with a jester hat out of shame and as a result is very insecure about them.

Imp heads are relatively large compared to their bodies, and have some vaguely reptilian traits, such as a lack of ears, lack of a defined nose, and their heads often have a slight conical point towards the upper lip. Imp head shape varies notably, such as Blitzo and Barbie Wire having elongated rear craniums. Although imps usually appear to lack any nostrils at all, they are revealed to actually have nostrils when actively smelling something. Their teeth are often shown as sharp and conical, and their tongues are forked like those of snakes.

Imp arms and legs have some amount of variation, they may have either plantigrade or digitigrade feet, typically with hooves or claws, which are usually black. Some imps may have natural high heels on their feet, as evidenced by Blitzo. Both Blitzo and Barbie Wire have wrists and ankles which are relatively thick and undefined.

As first shown in "Murder Family", imp blood is black. Some imps appear to produce animalistic sounds that are unique to individual imps. Examples include Blitzo generating cat-like purring, Moxxie's occasional habit of hissing like a cat when annoyed such as in "Seeing Stars", Striker's tendency to hiss and rattle his tail, and Millie making chittering shrieks when angered. Some imps, like Blitzo and Striker, have spikes down their back, tail, and head.

Abilities

Ocular illumination - Imps have the natural ability to project light from their eyes when they are in dimly lit areas.
Pyrokinesis - At least some imps are capable of producing flames, such as the imp carnie in "Loo Loo Land", who lights a cigarette made from a bill with a flick of his finger.
Earthly fire immunity - As shown in "Murder Family", imps are completely resistant to the fire of Earth, and being fully engulfed in it does no harm to them. It is unknown if this is an ability unique to imps, or if it is a trait all demons possess.
Prehensile tail - Imps are able to use their tail to grasp things, such as when shown in "The Harvest Moon Festival" that Blitzo uses his tail to grab Striker and throw him with it.
Elastic tongue - As shown by Blitzo in "Murder Family", imps can shoot out their tongue to catch food midair.
Smell - Although not as strong as a Hellhounds sense of smell, Imps are capable of smelling unique things, like the "scent of the living world" on Sinners, which allows them to indicate that they recently died. This was shown when with Blitzo who smelled Loopty Goopty and deduce that he had recently just died due to his human scent.
Flight - Some imps are born with wings behind their backs,[5] which grants them the ability to fly.
Blizto, Moxxie, Barbie Wire feral
Imps on large dosage of heroin
Drug tolerance - While imps can become dependent or addicted to drugs, such as the Hell drug H-8, to the point they need to be rehabilitated, it would appear they are very tolerant when it comes to the effects of earthly drugs such as heroin, as Blitzo claims that heroin barely gets rid of a headache in "Unhappy Campers". Much like their immunity to earthly fire, it remains unknown if this is a trait other demons possess. That said, imps suddenly being covered with large amounts of heroin can apparently affect them into becoming feral and violent.
Mortality

Unlike demon royalty and sinners, it appears in the episode "Loo Loo Land" that imps can be killed by non-Angelic Weapons. For unknown reasons, either due to being members of the lowest class of demons or being a hellborn species, imps can suffer fatal wounds from regular weapons, such as knives and guns, or can even die from being petrified into stone from Stolas' gaze. A headshot from a gun has also been shown to be significant enough to kill an imp completely. In the episode "The Harvest Moon Festival", it is confirmed by Millie's parents that imps can indeed be killed, such as during a natural disaster or during a violent festival event.

Although imps possess a certain resistance to fire, this seems to depend on the type of fire: Blitzo and Millie were observed being consumed by fire from Earth and emerging unharmed in "Murder Family", while in "Oops", Blitzo and Fizzarolli sustained injury to a fire that broke out in Hell. This suggests that their resistance is restricted to Earthly fire. It can also be assumed that smoke inhalation is still fatal to imps, as suggested by a group of firefighting imps wearing gas masks in the course of their work.

In "Ghostf**kers", Blitzo mentions that imps can suffer and can die from conditions such as heart attacks and diabetes.

Despite having a high tolerance to drugs and alcohol, a hellhound in "Queen Bee" says that Blitzo is gonna die during the drinking challenge with Beelzebub. It is implied that the drink he consumed was most likely Beelzejuice, an alcoholic beverage made in Hell by Beelzebub, which may also imply that the high alcohol and drug tolerance may not apply to specific Hell-made drugs and alcohol and imps could die from consuming high amounts.

Gallery

Concept art of a crowd of imps in "The Circus"
Concept art of a crowd of imps in "The Circus"
Trivia

In European mythology, an imp is a minor type of fairy or demon that is typically more mischievous than threatening, and as such is deemed a lesser being, even servile, to supernatural entities-- this may be part of the inspiration for imps in the series.
In the episode "Murder Family", Blitzo is injured by a bullet while in the human world and later implies that a shot to the head would send them back to Hell. This statement may be true based on Millie's reaction but has never been outright confirmed or denied.
It is possible that young imps are called "Implings", as Robo Fizz and Mammon addresses them as such in his show.
According to Striker, imps don't typically start businesses on their own due to how low they are in Hell's hierarchy or from just the low income they receive.
As hinted in Stolas' greeting before he starts the ritual for the Harvest Moon Festival, the majority of imp-kind appear to be native to the Wrath Ring, and much less present elsewhere.
This is further implied in the episode "Western Energy" where a demon assumes Blitzo is from Wrath because he's an imp.
In the episode "Western Energy" it is revealed that imps are called "fire toads" by higher ranking demons. In the St. An's Hospital waiting room a child calls Blitzo a "fire toad" which results in Blitzo becoming visibly offended and confronting the child, and the child's mother responds by saying, "it's not polite to call them that to their face, wait until we get in the car", which may imply it is some type of racial slur.
As shown in "Oops", scarring contributes to the development of an imp's white skin markings. This was previously implied by the cut and bruise patterns seen among imps in the show. However, given there are imps with markings that resemble non-scarred tissue such as freckles, it is unknown if white markings may be caused by other factors.
Despite being equal rank, imps can own/adopt hellhounds for personal labor or as pets.
As shown in the episode "Mastermind", on Blitzo's phone reads a news article celebrating I.M.P for surviving their trial, stating they were the first Hellborns to ever survive a trial by the Seven Deadly Sins.

"You are all such disgusting, loathsome beasts! Your kind is nothing but dirt that shitty dead people tread on! And now you're trying to meddle with the lives of humans?!"
―Keenie ranting about her hatred of demons to I.M.P
Keenie is a cherub angel who appears in the Helluva Boss episode "C.H.E.R.U.B". She is a former member of C.H.E.R.U.B and is a supporting antagonist alongside Cletus and Collin.

She was later banished from Heaven alongside her co-workers for indirectly killing a human. Later, in "The Full Moon", she and her co-workers joined with the agents of D.H.O.R.K.S. to take revenge on I.M.P.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Keenie is a small cherub who takes the appearance of an anthropomorphic sheep with light yellow skin, and slight darker-colored ears and hair which is short-cut and puffed upwards. Her eyes have light reddish-pink irises with periwinkle-colored pupils, and upper eyelids colored in a shade of faded light pink.

Her outlines and eyelashes are colored in a shade of dark purple, and she has a white halo hovering above her head, and a pair of pale yellow-and-white feathered wings on her back. She also has pale rosy-cheeks, and pink heart-shaped hooves.

Keenie wears a yellow dress with a pink hem and a large bow on the front, along with white frilly gloves and a pair of bloomers underneath her dress.
Personality

Keenie poses with a very kind demeanor and attempts to inspire others through her job. She is shown to be very dedicated for her work both as an angel and in C.H.E.R.U.B, not hesitating to head into combat if outside forces don't go her way.

She doesn't, however, seem to be totally invested in the lives of her clients, and instead appears to only want to help them out of obligation to her job rather than out of sympathy.

Being an angel, Keenie has a very modest nature having low tolerance to what she finds indecent, such as Blitzo making an inappropriate joke or when Collin uses the Lord's name in vain.

However, she appears to have total and absolute disregard for Hell and its inhabitants, as she refers to them as disgusting, loathsome beasts that "shitty dead people" tread on.

Ironically, she is shown to cuss when angered to a high point, even though she still considers I.M.P's actions and slang inappropriate, along with chastising Collin for accidentally using the Lord's name in vain even though she has used far worse language than he has.

She has also shown to be the most aggressive and violent of the cherubs, kickstarting the brawl between them and the imps when Millie pushed her too far.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Flight - Along with all the other abilities of Cherubs, Keenie can fly due to her wings, and can fly quite quickly and is swift with her wings in battle, even though her wings are quite small.
Weapon summoning - Like all other Cherubs, Keenie has the ability to summon an angelic crossbow that's unique to her, as well as golden arrows to load it with. When released from the crossbow, these arrows leave behind a visible trail of bright sparkling golden light.
Enhanced strength - Keenie is seen effortlessly lifting a large boulder during the C.H.E.R.U.B commercial.
Pyligenesis - As demonstrated in her debut episode, she was the one to summon a portal back to Heaven for herself and her fellow co-workers. Despite it still functioning as intended, those who are banished from Heaven are banned from re-entering from said portal. It is currently unknown if this is a feat unique to only her or a selected few, or if every other Cherub has the same ability.
Exoskeleton Proficiency - along with his colleagues, Keenie is capable of piloting and fighting with the weaponized exoskeletons provided by D.H.O.R.K.S.
Skillset

Archery - Along with her co-workers, Keenie is seen to be proficient with her crossbow being able to shoot many arrows at high speeds.
Musical Talent - In the beginning of the episode "C.H.E.R.U.B", she is able to sing the lyrics on rhythm.

―Mammon, flirting with Leviathan
Leviathan is a minor character in Helluva Boss who made her official debut in the episode "Mastermind". She is one of the Seven Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Envy.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Leviathan is a two-headed piscine demoness with a dichotomy in her anatomy: her body is divided into two, indicated by the left half of her body appearing white and the right half of her body indigo. Both heads share lengthy fin-like white hair styled in a mohawk. However, the left head is more humanoid, has webbed ears and electric blue eyes with black sclera and cyan eyeshadow, while the right is more animalistic, has a longer neck, pupilless seafoam green eyes, and a fanged, eel-like snout. In addition, the left head's hair has faint pink streaks on it with a black strip and violet gradient interior; the right head's hair is bioluminescent, with black streaks on the topside, a dark violet-cyan gradient interior, and green spots scattered across.

Leviathan wears a sleeveless high-collar black crop top with a diamond-shaped cutout and twin downward-facing swirls, the right swirl being violet and the left swirl lavender. She wears a black skirt featuring a semicircle-patterned rim bearing the same color split as the swirls. She also wears elbow-length gloves; black on the left and white on the right. Each head wears a light cyan pearl necklace with only the left head wearing pearl earrings, and has a cyan belt to match.
Personality

While the full extent of her personality has yet to be revealed, Leviathan's two heads appear to have independent personalities. The right head is more cynical and more in charge, while the left head appears to be relaxed and composed. The left head was even friendly to Mammon, unlike the right, and got mad when the right head moved them away from him. The relationship of the two heads is further indicated when Mammon invited Leviathan out after Blitzo's trial; the right head showed active annoyance at Mammon and attempted to ignore him, but her left head seemed to genuinely enjoy being around him, and looked hopefully at the right head, indicating that she hoped that she would allow them to take up Mammon's offer.

It is unknown if she shares the same views of superiority as the other deadly sins do. However, she does recognize Satan as her leader and "the law" of Hell.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

Not much is known about Leviathan's history other than at some point she joined Lucifer as part of the Deadly Sins, with her embodying the sin of Envy.

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Mastermind"

Leviathan is present during Blitzo's trial with her fellow sins on the illegal use of Stolas' grimoire. During the trial, Mammon flirts with Leviathan a few times, and the right head moves her seat away from Mammon when he flirts again, to the left head's frustration. When the court votes on whether to continue the trial or execute Blitzo, Leviathan's vote is not shown, but once he is sentenced to execution, Mammon offers to take her out after things wrap up, which gets the left head excited for while the right head recoils. Leviathan is later surprised when Stolas sings that he is the mastermind and manipulated Blitzo's usage of the grimoire. She then watched Mammon grossly eat his food.

Abilities

Bioluminescence - Her hair can glow, even in dark environments.
Skillset

Musical talent - During Satan's song, Leviathan and the rest of the Sins can be seen singing in a choir-esque fashion, backing up the former's vocals.
ADVERTISEMENT
Gallery

Leviathan/Gallery
Trivia

Leviathan is based on the mythological demon of the same name, who is often depicted as a massive sea serpent or whale.
In Binsfeld's classification of demons, Leviathan is one of the seven Princes of Hell, representing Envy. Likewise, Leviathan in Helluva Boss is the embodiment of Envy.
Leviathan having two heads with opposing personalities may be a reference to the concept of two-faced envy, the idea of envy having two aspects: "benign envy" (admiration) and "malicious envy" (resentment).
The symbol that appears on the back of Leviathan's seat and on the rings Satan uses to strip Stolas' powers is known as the Leviathan's Cross, and is the alchemical symbol for brimstone.
This symbol can also be seen on Charlie Morningstar's bowtie in the Hazbin Hotel pilot.
Leviathan is depicted as female in the Hellaverse, as opposed to her real-life demonological counterpart, who is typically portrayed as male. Though, it should be noted that the Book of Enoch (60:7–9) describes Leviathan as a female monster that lives in the watery abyss.
According to Vivziepop, Leviathan and Satan were planned to be the most traditional in sticking with the usual themes in terms of design, but at that time of June 26, 2023, she was still working on finalizing them.[1]
As shown on Blitzo's phone in the episode "Ozzie's", Leviathan's image is used for a TikTok-like app called "Envee".
Leviathan can be seen with a cigarette holder in her introduction, indicating she is a smoker.

Lin is the mother of Millie and Sallie May, and the wife of Joe. She and her husband are also the owners of the Rough n' Tumbleweed Ranch.

She is a minor character who made her debut alongside her husband in "The Harvest Moon Festival".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Lin bears a striking resemblance to her oldest daughter, Millie, with the exception of having numerous white spot-markings all over her body, graying-hair, and burgundy cloven hooves. Her body type is rather voluptuous, with prominently large breasts, a narrow waist, wide hips and thick thighs.

She is seen dressed in a maroon ascot around her neck, a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a light gray upper-section in which thin black tassels are seen hanging from it, dark brown gardening gloves and a belt with a gray buckle, and pale blue-gray jeans.
Young

In a photo of when Lin was younger, she lacked the white spots on her face that she has as an adult, and her hair was much darker and in a style that was less messy and more closer to Millie's hairstyle during "Ozzie's".

In this picture, she is seen wearing a black dress with puffed sleeves.

Personality

Lin is generally a friendly woman to people she likes and is a very caring mother. Like her husband, Lin has a fondness for war and violence.

At first, they both take a liking to Blitzo due to his compliment on Millie being resilient, and as his name conjures up thoughts of war.

She, along with her husband, is not fond of Moxxie, given his diminutive stature and preference for ranged weapons, and would instead prefer someone with enough physical strength to stand their ground without using anything except their bare hands.

Lin has a habit of scolding Millie for getting too carried away with her violent tendencies, noted when she reminded Millie of her role in causing nine out of fifteen funerals in the Pain Games.

Despite this, Lin lets Sallie May get away with killing an indiscriminate amount of demons. It is suggested this is because she was successful in hiding the bodies.

Although, this side seems to be due to the fact that she wanted Millie to use her physical strength in a more calm manner to her advantage, rather than mindlessly attacking without care. This was shown when she scolded Millie for letting her rage get the best of her when she faced Striker, claiming she raised her better than that (although Lin may have been angry at her for losing the fight).
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

Not much known about Lin's past other than she married Joe at some point and have five children together.

Lin and Joe would bring Millie and their other children to Loo Loo Land when they could afford to.[4]

Helluva Boss Season 1

"The Harvest Moon Festival"

When I.M.P come to Rough n' Tumbleweed Ranch for the Harvest Moon Festival, Lin greets Millie and then shows her distaste for Moxxie and meet Blitzo. After Joe mentions the Pain Games, Lin reminds Millie that she can't compete because she previously caused nine funerals.

A couple days later whilst Lin bandages Millie's arm, she scolds Millie for not doing better against Striker until Moxxie stands up for Millie and scolds Lin and Joe.

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Sinsmas"

On Sinsmas, Lin was sitting alongside her family watching television. She looks worried as she notices Sallie Mae leaving the room to answer Millie's call.

―Loopty Goopty, introducing himself
Loopty Goopty is a sinner demon and co-founder of Lyle-Loopty Robotics alongside his partner and best friend, Lyle Lipton.

He is a minor character in Helluva Boss who made his debut alongside Lyle in "C.H.E.R.U.B".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Human

As an adult human Loopty had a muscular build. His hair was styled horn-like and a black handlebar mustache. He wore a shirt, gloves pants, boots, goggles with swirly lens, and a cape.

When forcibly aged, Loopty became scrawny to the point his skeleton was visible, he was balding, and his hair was grey.

Sinner

In his Sinner form, Loopty is a fairly tall demon that primarily has a red color scheme, with a lighter red face, along with darker red horns and nose, which is prominently long, and a black handlebar mustache.

He wears a black top hat with a neon green band on his head and a pair of acid green goggles with dark green swirls in the lenses and a black strap on his face. His outfit consists of a black jumpsuit with a bright green neck piece, along with a bright green curve shape on his chest and stomach that reaches the groin, resembling that of a question mark. He also wears red gloves on his hands, bright green boots, and a blood red cape.

He has several black mechanical tentacles with red outlines that can extend and retract out of his back.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Loopty is described by himself and others to be a very eccentric person, and often does ridiculously eccentric things to the extreme for no reason at times.

Like his business partner, Loopty is a very greedy man with little to no care about anyone or anything else and expresses an innate desire to take vengeance on other people, even though they didn’t do anything to wrong him in the first place.

A prime example being when he wanted Lyle dead for surviving their failed experiment when he himself did not. He is also somewhat petty and if not a bit childish for this. However, it was later revealed that he only acted like this as I.M.P kill people for revenge and in reality he wanted to reunite with Lyle.

Loopty is also highly intelligent, being an inventor, but often uses these inventions for the wrong reasons. Despite this, he did care about Lyle, his best friend and business partner.
Abilities

Immortality - As a Sinner, Loopty is biologically immortal, being unable to die from illnesses and unable to age, remaining the same age as when he died, thus can not die of old age and other natural causes. He also cannot die from any kind of damage to the body, and will recover from any injury, however, he can only be permanently killed with angelic weaponry.
Cybernetic limbs - Loopty has the ability to summon mechanical limbs that emerge from his body.
Weapon summoning - Loopty is able to summon a variety of weapons, such as a pistol, circular saw, and a double-barrel shotgun.
Skillset

Wide intellect - Loopty is shown to be quite the genius, as he and his business partner invented an anti-aging machine, and co-founded a company that eventually grew into a technological empire.
ADVERTISEMENT

Gallery

Loopty Goopty/Gallery
Trivia

His name may be a combination of the words "Loopy", "Goopy" and "Humpty Dumpty". With "Loopy" meaning "eccentric or bizarre", and "goopy" alternatively meaning "mawkishly sentimental".
Similar to Alastor, he and Lyle both still retain their human names upon arriving in Hell.
Loopty's retractable mechanical arms are reminiscent to those of Spider-Man villain Doctor Octopus.
He is the first I.M.P client to have someone assassinated not out of revenge.
Loopty shares two similar traits with Blitzo.
They both are voiced by Brandon Rogers.
They both dislike it whenever anyone mispronounces their names.
Coincidentally months after the episode's premiere, Brandon had a character with a similar name, who was also an inventor, in one of his videos named Gloria Goopty (played by Kornbread Jeté), specifically in the A Day with a Robot (NOT FOR HUMANS) video.
He resembles the human form of Jinxer from Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue.

―Lyle Lipton, explaining why he is in Hell
Lyle Lipton is the co-founder of Lyle-Loopty Robotics and was I.M.P's target in his debut episode, "C.H.E.R.U.B".

He is the co-worker of Loopty Goopty and a minor character in Helluva Boss.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Human

As an adult human, Lyle was a rather short man with a mustache and indeterminate hair color, with two tufts of hair poking up towards the back. He wore dark gloves, an overcoat, some light colored goggles with spirals on them and what could be a tank top under the coat with brown pants and boots.

When forcibly aged, his nose and head underwent rather massive growths, easily doubling in size. His mustache is all that remains of his hair, which is now light grey. As an elderly man, he wore a pale blue shirt and a diaper.

Sinner

In his Sinner form, Lyle has a robotic appearance with a round, spherical body with his head on top and arms on his sides. He has mint-green skin with a red triangular patch on his chin, a large bushy light grey mustache, and a pair of red pince-nez goggles with dark red spirals on the lens.

He wears a light green vest with a dark outline on top and one button on the front, a dark bowler hat with a red stripe, and a pair of light green gloves on his hands. With his lower half being a ball and lacking legs, he gets around simply by rolling. His teeth resemble that of piano keys.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

As described by Moxxie, Lyle is a selfish, greedy and authoritarian capitalist. His greed is so great that, when he at first was ready to die, Lyle had a stock photo of money that he said goodbye to. He has little to no care about other things, especially when it comes to experimenting upon poor people, and despises children, despite admiring their innocence at times.

At first, he is suicidal and unwilling to live with his old body before the intervention of C.H.E.R.U.B. In the end he saw the value in life after watching the cherubs and imps fight, realizing his life must be worth something if supernatural beings were fighting over it.

While appearing to show some affection towards a few of the concepts C.H.E.R.U.B showed him, such as children indulging in innocence and romance, he ultimately could not overcome his sense of greed.
Abilities

Immortality - As a Sinner, Lyle is biologically immortal, being unable to die from illnesses and unable to age, remaining the same age as when he died, thus can not die of old age and other natural causes. He also cannot die from any kind of damage to the body, and will recover from any injury, however, he can only be permanently killed with angelic weaponry.
Skillset

Wide intellect - Lyle is shown to be quite the genius, as he and his business partner invented an anti-aging machine, and co-founded a company that eventually grew into a technological empire.
ADVERTISEMENT
Gallery

Lyle Lipton/Gallery
Trivia

Lyle's demon form resembles that of Bigweld from the movie Robots. He also partly resembles Dr. Eggman from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise.
Lyle's demon teeth being piano keys is a nod to his cause of death.
It is also a possible reference to classic cartoons where a character, crushed by a piano, is then seen with keys having replaced their teeth.
Similar to Alastor, he and Loopty Goopty both still retain their human names upon arriving in Hell.
Coincidentally, Brandon Rogers had a character with the same first-name, Lyle Lemon (portrayed by Jack Plotnick), in his A Day at the Beach video

The better the impression, the more they'll want a piece of you they can take home and fuck! Don't you want that, Fizzie? To be fucked?!"

Mammon is a character in Helluva Boss whose iconography is first pictured throughout the episode "Loo Loo Land" and makes his official debut in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)".

He is the owner of the theme park Loo Loo Land in the Greed Ring[2] and the former boss of Fizzarolli. He is also one of the Seven Deadly Sins, embodying the sin of Greed.

Appearance

Mammon is a rotund, four-armed demon who resembles a jester. He has neon green eyes with what appears to be an eye mask, and sharp neon green teeth with a tongue that's forked and purple with at least three dark yellow stripes inside his mouth.

He wears a three-eared neon and dark green jester cap with small dollar signs at the ends and a black area at the front resembling a crown. He wears a jester's collar colored half-dark green and half-neon green with yellow trim at the bottom and has black diamonds.

Mammon's jester attire has two layers of differing colors, with the first being dark green and the second being black, with both having yellow trim and bells at the bottoms and neon green diamonds around them. The sleeves fit into his gloves and are asymmetric, one on each side being dark green and black while the other has white and pale blue stripes.

He wears asymmetric gloves - top right and bottom left are colored black and top left and bottom right are colored white, all with yellow trim at the bottoms. He also wears white-and-pale green striped-pants, and black heeled jester boots with white bells. He carries a yellow cane topped with a large dollar sign.
Past

Years prior to the series during his concert, Mammon had skinny arms and a visible neck, and overall he appeared shorter. His eye mask had thick neon green borders and shiny black lenses, giving the appearance of shades.

He wore a three-eared blue and light blue jester cap with green ball at the ends, a black dollar sign at the front, and two additional ears on the left from the back. He wears a jester's light blue-green collar with a gap at the front where a coin sits in the middle and white trim at the bottom.

Mammon's jester attire had two layers of differing colors, with the first being pale blue, the second having pale blue and light blue vertical stripes, and both having white trim at the bottoms. The sleeves are loose and asymmetric, with the ones on the right being singular colors of pale blue and light blue. At the same time, the left side has both pale blue and light blue, with jagged lines separating the colors. Each sleeve has white trim at the ends.

He wears asymmetric gloves with two colors, black and two colored white. He also wears black-and-yellow-striped pants, and jester-like white platform boots with dark purple soles. He also had a yellow guitar with jester cap-like ears at the top.

Full Demon

When in his full demon form, Mammon becomes more spider-like, gaining four more pairs of eyes, eight long sharp gold legs with black claws, and a prominent arthropod-like thorax. His jester cap's ears also become sharper. He is shorter than Asmodeus, who in full demon form has to bend down to be at his eye level.

Personality

Befitting the sin he embodies, Mammon is very egotistical and greedy, and he doesn't care for the well-being of others, only caring about how much he can profit from them to indulge his own greed. Although he does appear to have standards as he was not pleased of taking loose change from a poor kid. Mammon acts friendly in front of his audience just to look the part and treats Fizzarolli like a son.

From what Fizzarolli has stated, Mammon is also a perfectionist. As his brand face, Mammon wants zero flaws in his brand figure whatsoever. He is also abusive, forcing Fizzarolli to do many stunts that put Fizzarolli in danger, such as being a living target for knife-throwing. However, Mammon also seems to show genuine concern over Fizzarolli when he starts having a panic attack, although it quickly changes to him looking threateningly and demanding for him to "get [his] shit together".

He has a foul mouth, even more so than most demons, even saying "c***" several times. He is also a chauvinist, publicly stating women "just ain't funny". Still, he claims to have reconsidered such comments upon seeing Glitz and Glam's performance and the twins becoming finalists.

There is also an ignorant side of him, such as when Fizzarolli is singing "2 Minutes Notice", he is unable to notice that the song is about him, even after Asmodeus says it is, and only realizes when Fizzarolli calls Mammon by name.

Mammon is also shown to be fairly confident in his own might, not being intimidated when Asmodeus, a fellow Sin, came to Fizzarolli's defense. Though he also shows he seemingly prefers not to fight directly, retreating when his threat to reveal Fizzarolli and Asmodeus' relationship fell flat, suggesting him to be somewhat cowardly despite his bloated ego. He is also known to be lazy as Asmodeus stated that he had not performed anymore clown acts and Blitzo called the last show he attended being an overhyped commercial.
Abilities

Longevity - As mentioned by Asmodeus in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", Mammon has existed since at least the start of hell, meaning he is thousands of years old and presumably is unable to die of old age.
Demon transformation - Mammon can transform into a more powerful demonic arachnid form with a larger size and multiple eyes and legs.
Electrokinesis - He can generate sparks of green electricity from his body and generate sparks of green lightning when he teleports.
Typhokinesis - He can generate green smoke from his mouth, and also when he teleports.
Get ready for a bloody special Meet n' Greet with ✨💲MAMMON💲✨
Teleporting
Teleportation - He is capable of teleporting from one area to another, which he does so with an explosion of green smoke and a charge of green lightning that turn into $ signs, with audible cash register sound effect. Though the sound effect is absent when he confronts Fizzarolli on his resignation, implying that the sound effects may be based on his mood or emotions.
Fragokinesis - Mammon was shown to be able to generate explosions when he teleports and caused Mammon Theatre to explode at the end of "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)".
Skillset

Guitar-playing - During his entrance in a flashback, he is shown playing the guitar.
Charisma - His overall fun and optimistic demeanor and behavior gathers the admiration of all his fans when he shows up, even drawing the attention of Fizzarolli.
Singing - In "Mastermind", he sings in choir with the other Sins.
Gallery

Mammon/Gallery
Trivia

Mammon's name in Hebrew means "money", which has then been adopted in modern Hebrew to also mean "wealth".
Mammon is based on the real-life demon of the same name, a Prince of Hell representing Greed in Binsfeld's classification of demons.
The symbol that appears on Mammon's stage in his debut episode, as well as on the back of his seat and on the rings Satan uses in "Mastermind", is not based on any real-life symbol of the demon. Rather, it is a quasi-unofficial sigil of Mammon originally created by occultist Augustus Grigori in the style of a Goetia seal.[3][4]
Mammon is the third of the deadly sins to debut.
As shown in his contract regarding the issues for his theme park, Mammon claims that he and Lucifer Morningstar are friends.
As shown in the contract Robo Fizz shows the audience before starting his song, Mammon's signature includes a small doodle of himself next to it.
Mammon's signature and portrait appear on the banknotes for a hundred Souls, just as how authorized figures have their signatures and portraits featured on banknotes in real life.
Mammon previously owned the character of Fizzarolli, and by extension his robotic duplicates, Robo Fizz, which Big Ozzie's Factory produces.
He also appears to own a cereal brand called "Greed Seeds", as shown in the episode "Loo Loo Land".
He also appears to own the banking app called "Moneymakerz Bank", as seen on Blitzo's hellphone in the episode "Ozzie's".
The symbol of Mammon appears on the wall inside the bank Moxxie and Chaz rob in "Exes and Oohs", implying that Mammon may own said bank.
Mammon's iconography appears on an oil container Millie takes from Chaz's car in "Exes and Oohs", which may imply he owns an oil and gas industry.
In "Exes and Oohs" he is shown to have his own radio channel called "Mammon Channel", playing the Loo Loo Land song.
Mammon official xmas sneak peak
Sneak peek of Mammon
According to Vivienne the McDonald's villain, Evil Grimace, has Mammon energy.[5]
On December 24, 2022, the official Helluva Boss Twitter account posted a sneak peek silhouette image of Mammon, in celebration of Australian Christmas.[6]
The tweet being released on an Australian holiday and Mammon's quote in it foreshadowed Mammon's Australian accent.[6]
His voice actor, Michael Cusack, is also Australian.
The same tweet also revealed Mammon's body shape slightly resembles a Christmas tree; coupled with the fact it was released during Christmas, this connects to the holiday being portrayed via commercialism and Mammon being the Sin of Greed.
The explosion Mammon uses to teleport is how he gets around, and has confetti and a little royalty free children cheer accompanying it.[7]
In "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", according to Asmodeus, he has known Mammon since "the start of Hell", implying that the two are as old, or older, than Hell itself.
In the Hazbin Hotel episode "The Show Must Go On", Lucifer mentions that Hell has been around for at least 10,000 years, implying Mammon is more than 10,000 years old.
In "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", Asmodeus says that Mammon has stopped doing clown things.
Mammon's spider-like appearance might be a reference to Pennywise from It, a clown-like creature who eventually takes on the form of a monstrous spider.
Furthermore, his body shape, use of the color green, and his bug-like features resemble Oogie Boogie from The Nightmare Before Christmas.
His body could also be compared to a tick, another arachnid, that could represent his toxic and parasitic nature and how he harmfully subsists off of others' work at their expense.
In the episode "Mastermind", on the door to Satan's court, also shown in official SharkRobot merchandise released for the episode, the silhouette logo of Mammon in his full demon form shows him as a centipede instead.

―Martha hunting Blitzo
Martha is a sinner demon and a minor antagonist of Helluva Boss who made her debut in "Murder Family".

As a human, Martha was the wife of Ralphie and the mother of two unnamed children. She drove Mrs. Mayberry past her breaking point after she was caught sleeping with the latter's husband.

After her death, she became a Sinner in Hell, and in "Apology Tour", is seen living with Mrs. Mayberry.

Appearance

Human

When she was human, Martha sported the appearance of a tall, hourglass figure and peach bud-skinned Southern Belle with wavy, hip-length blonde hair with two paler-colored streaks. Under her hair is a bandage wrapped around her forehead from Mrs. Mayberry's attacks.

Her eyes are coffee-brown with small pupils, long and thin eyelashes protruding from them, and a mole under the right eye. Her makeup consists of lavender eyeshadow and magenta lip gloss on her lips.

When being introduced, Martha wore a set of rather large, tiffany blue-colored triangular dangle earrings, a white-trimmed tiffany blue-colored off-the-shoulder top, red bracelets on both her wrists, a knee-length, red polka-dotted cream skirt, and a pair of red high-heels.

During the majority of "Murder Family", Martha instead wore a skin-tight, off-the-shoulder, red polka-dotted cream top with tiffany blue-colored capri skinny jeans, though she still kept the earrings, bracelets and heels.

When she shows her true colors, her hair got ruffled, her earrings turned into skulls, her jeans (whose style has been swapped with her top, and vice-versa) became ripped, her teeth became sharp, and her eyes turned red.

Sinner

As a sinner demon, Martha retains her body shape, but with more devilish features, as her skin has become red with her hands being black. Her hair is longer, thicker and bushier, and is now colored in a shade of grayish-purple with thin red streaks on the darker-colored highlights.

Her left eye has a black sclera with a pink iris and a slit pupil, while her right is an empty black socket with black blood dripping out of it, as a nod to the wound that led to her death, and her upper eyelids are colored in a darker shade of her skin. She now sports black cloven hooves, a mouth with sharp teeth and dark red lips, and a pair of branch-like black horns with red accents protruding from her head.

Martha retains the same outfit, but with certain differences - her earrings are black skulls with red eyes, her top now has tears on the rims and with a black-trimmed, zig-zagged-shaped stripe running along the cleavage, and her jeans are longer and are now the same color as her horns.

Personality

At first glance, one would assume Martha and her family would be "happy and wholesome", as Moxxie described. In reality, Martha and her family are homicidal maniacs who worship Satan and his "dark work". She also appears to partake in cannibalism and human flaying with her family. She is shown to sleep with other men many times, though it is unclear if she had an open relationship or if she used it to lure in victims or was simply unfaithful.

Despite being a Satanist, Martha has a poor understanding of how Hell works as she was unaware that earthly fire could not kill nor banish demons, which she realized after trying to set Millie and Blitzo aflame.

As a sinner demon in Hell, Martha seems to have moved on in her afterlife. When Blitzo visits her, Martha is unhappy to see Blitzo but does not show direct animosity toward the imp. Another sign of this change is her living with Mrs. Mayberry, despite their sour relations in the past; her comment after Blitzo gave Mrs. Mayberry a look implied they were in a relationship.
Abilities

Immortality - As a Sinner, Martha is biologically immortal, being unable to die from illnesses and unable to age, remaining the same age as when She died, thus can not die of old age and other natural causes. She also cannot die from any kind of damage to the body, and will recover from any injury, however, she can only be permanently killed with angelic weaponry.
Skillset

Charisma - She was capable of tricking most people into believing she was a nice person and was well-liked by them, even being praised as a "hero" after she survived the attack from Mrs. Mayberry.
Weapon proficiency - As shown in her debut episode, she is experienced at handling weaponry, particularly firearms.
Gallery

Martha/Gallery
Trivia

Martha's voice actor, Jinkx Monsoon, originally recorded their lines remotely in Portland, Oregon.[1]
Martha also shares her voice actor with Party Girl, Crane, Rita, and the elevator.
The name "Martha" appears during the news scene of the Hazbin Hotel pilot, specifically the line "I'm so sorry, Martha. I shouldn't have done it". It is unknown if this was referring to the same or a different person.
After Martha was killed by Moxxie, Martha became a demon in Hell, which is shown during the episode "Apology Tour" where she is seen living with Mrs. Mayberry. It is implied that they are in a relationship, based on Martha's comments after Blitzo gave her a knowing look. Them being in a relationship and/or attracted to each other was also suggested by their appearance as a 2025 Valentine's Day "Couple Keychain".[2]
It is unknown what the fate of Martha's family was after their deaths, and if they were condemned to Hell and became demons like Martha is still unknown.
It is shown in "Loo Loo Land" that Blitzo keeps Martha's eye in a jar in his office as a memento.

Martha and Ralphie's children were the unnamed daughter and son of Martha and Ralphie. They made their debut alongside their parents in the Helluva Boss episode "Murder Family".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Martha and Ralphie's children are short humans. When feral, they sported rather abnormal features, such as red eyes and sharp teeth.

The female child is taller and has peach-bud skin with freckled-cheeks, brown eyes with small pupils and long eyelashes, and long auburn-streaked hair that she tied-back into pigtails with straight bangs. She is dressed in a lavender blouse with a darker-colored bow on the collar, a maroon plaid skirt, and brown cowboy boots.

The male child has tanned-skin with freckled-cheeks, small black and beady eyes, a small round nose and blonde-light orange, shoulder-length hair with shaved sides. He is dressed in a bearskin hat that he uses to hide his weapon, an off-white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, brown shorts with a black belt that has a gold buckle, and muddy green rainboots.
Personality

Like their parents, the children are nice, cheerful people in the public eye but they are actually homicidal maniacs who worship Satan.

However, they did maintain a loving relationship with their family, as shown from when they were visibly upset over their mother's death and were comforted by their father over this, and embraced their father after he affectionately stated buying the universal remote for them.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

Little is known about the kids' history except that they were born to Martha and Ralphie and were with Martha in the hospital after she was attacked by Mrs. Mayberry.

Helluva Boss Season 1

"Murder Family"

Whilst having dinner Blitzo prepares to shoot and kill Martha, Moxxie panics over killing a possibly innocent family and makes Blitzo's shot miss. The kids and their parents pull out guns and begin hunting the imps, with Ralphie claiming to be for tomorrow nights dinner.

Before Moxxie can flee, the kids grab him and he wakes up tied to a chair where attempts to make peace with them, but then they creepily tell him "it's nice to have a new critter to play with", disturbing him. When Moxxie sees around the room the remains of human used for decoration and begins to struggle in his restraints, the girl pulls out a knife but Moxxie knocks over the chair onto her and uses her knife to get free and races into the forest.

Shortly after their mother is killed in a failed "ritual" with the imps, the children and their father are held at gunpoint by Moxxie; however, he chooses to spare them and calls the police to give the family a chance at life and to possibly redeem themselves.

The local authorities promptly arrive, but instead of attempting to apprehend them, a police helicopter fires a missile at the house, annihilating the house with the family still inside, much to Moxxie's horror.

ADVERTISEMENT
Trivia

The daughter shares the same voice actor as young Octavia, with both being voiced by Juliana Sada.
They are so far the youngest antagonists I.M.P has faced against.

Moxxie's mother is the unnamed mother of Moxxie, the wife of Crimson and a minor character in Helluva Boss. She has only appeared in flashbacks and was first pictured in "Exes and Oohs".

 
ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Moxxie's mother is a fairly tall, light red-skinned imp with a long demonic tail with white spots on the tip. She has black lips and eyes with yellow sclera, long eyelashes and black eyelids. She sports features similar to Moxxie's; such as freckles on her cheeks and digitigrade legs.

She has long, flowing and hip-length charcoal hair with bangs, and accessorizes with a red flower on the left side. Her hair also reveals her thin white-striped black horns, typical of female imps.

She is seen wearing a red-striped navy blue bodice with a large red bow tied around the waist, worn over a cobalt blue dress with red brims and a white-frilled trim on the puffed sleeves,a white high-frilled collar, and red and white stripes at the hem. She also wears white opera gloves, and white heels with red bows and soles, which is arguably her most noticeable feature.

In a family portrait with Crimson and Moxxie, she was wearing a Latin-American-inspired dress.
Personality

Moxxie's mother appears to be deeply caring and compassionate toward her son. During Moxxie's childhood flashback, she was seen helping cut his steak when he was struggling, and also congratulating him when he shoots three targets at a theme park shooting range.

She dislikes her husband, most noticeably because of his treatment of their son. She may fear him, as she was depicted moving her leg away from his while sitting at the dinner table.

When Crimson tries to have Moxxie shoot a live target, she shoves the gun back at Crimson and leads her son away, showing that she was against forcing Moxxie into such a lifestyle due to him being very young.

Their relationship seems to be so strained that Crimson was physically abusive to her at one point, and she left him.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

At some point, Moxxie's mother married Crimson and had a son, Moxxie. Unlike Crimson, Moxxie's mother treated Moxxie with love and care, and was very supportive of him. She also showed dislike towards Crimson's criminal activities and his abuse directed at her.[1]

Eventually, Moxxie's mother had enough of Crimson's abuse, and left with Moxxie. Unfortunately, she was later gone from Moxxie's life, implied to have died from Crimson's involvement. Her shoe was last seen floating on the water, after a younger Moxxie was forced to kill someone by pushing them off a boat.[1]

Gallery

Moxxie's mother/Gallery
Trivia

Although the fate of Moxxie's mother is unclear, it is hinted that she was drowned by Crimson after she had left him; one of her heels is visibly floating in the water of his body-dumping grounds. Whether or not the action was done by Crimson himself is currently unknown, but it is likely that he had arranged for it.
According to Vivienne Medrano, they tried to make the design of Moxxie's mom as Wrath/country-style as possible because she was born in the Wrath Ring.[2]
Her clothing is influenced by Latin-American Baroque style, her dress including elements of the baiana and pollera. Judging that her design is intended to be very Wrath-like,[2] this may infer a similarity between Latin-American aesthetics and Wrath aesthetics in the Hellaverse.
According to Medrano, Moxxie values his mother's side of his heritage far more than his dad's

"You do everything right in life, play by all the rules and still get sent down here with all the Hitlers and Epsteins of the world. After one measly massacre propelled by blind rage. So, that's why I'm here - to get my revenge."
―Mayberry to Blitzo
Mrs. Mayberry is a sinner demon and minor character in Helluva Boss who made her debut in "Murder Family".

She hired Blitzo and his crew to kill Martha, a woman whom she caught having an affair with her husband in her debut episode. In "Apology Tour", Mrs. Mayberry and Martha appear to be living together.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Human

When she was a human, Mrs. Mayberry was a slim, tan-skinned woman with both sandy-green eyes and sandy-blonde waist-length hair which was more fluffy and curly at the lower portion. Tied around the back of her head was an accessorized sandy-green headscarf, and she also sported cherry-red lipstick on her lips.

Her attire consisted of oval-framed mustard-yellow glasses over her eyes, a long-sleeved cherry-printed cream blouse with a white peter-pan collar, black tights under a high-waisted, teal-blue maxi skirt with two gold buttons, and a pair of black flats.

Mrs. Mayberry's accessories included a set of small, round cherry-red earrings, and a gold-framed sandy-green brooch which adorned the front of her blouse.

Sinner

As a sinner demon, Mrs. Mayberry retains her body shape, but with more devilish features. Her skin is a light violet, her hair is messier and is colored in a light gray, her ears are larger and pointier, her lips are black with sharp yellow teeth inside, and her eyes sport red sclera and slit yellow pupils. When angry, her eyes glow with a red light and her hair starts waving around her head.

She gains a pointed tail, and has goat-like features such as horns and lavender-colored hooves. In addition, her headscarf is now black.

For clothing, she now sported cat-eyed glasses, diamond-shaped earrings and a yellow-tipped tear drop-shaped pin—all colored in salmon-pink. She wears a dark mauve-pink turtleneck with torn edges and salmon-pink stitching, alongside a high-waisted black maxi skirt that is torn at the hem, and it also features both salmon threaded seams and two salmon buttons.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Before her death, Mrs. Mayberry was a cheerful and kind person who had a passion for teaching children.

However, when she saw that her husband cheated on her, she snapped and was filled with murderous intent, although she was immediately horrified of killing him in front of her students after coming to her senses.

After her death, Mayberry became embittered to the thought of ending up in Hell for one act of blind rage after living a lifetime of otherwise good behavior. She was also out for revenge on the woman who was responsible for her death, which is why she went to Blitzo for this task. However, she seems to have changed her mind towards Martha sometime later, given how both women are now living together.

It seems she still has a sense of humor, joking about how the situation was messed up, but she paid for it.
Abilities

Immortality - As a Sinner, Mrs. Mayberry is biologically immortal, being unable to die from illnesses and unable to age, remaining the same age as when she died, thus can not die of old age and other natural causes. She also cannot die from any kind of damage to the body, and will recover from any injury, however, she can only be permanently killed with angelic weaponry.
Peak strength - Even before her death, she possessed incredible strength, able to throw one of her students with enough force to break through the school roof. Though, this could be a result of her anger.
Bioluminescence - When angry, she glows red.
Flowing hair - When angry, her hair flows in a similar manner as fire.
Skillset

Teaching - Being an elementary school teacher, she is shown to have the capability to educate them.
Musical talent - She leads the school day with a song she encourages the class to sing along to.
Gun proficiency - Although off-screen, she is capable of handling a gun, as when she someone and then herself.
Chainsaw proficiency - Although off-screen, she is capable of handling a chainsaw.
ADVERTISEMENT

Gallery

Mrs. Mayberry/Gallery
Trivia

Her last name, Mayberry, when used as a metaphor, means "a utopian setting" or "a perfect place to live". Whereas, as a noun, it is an ornamental bramble that bears white flowers and edible yellow fruit.
She is the first denizen of Hell in the series who has been shown in both their living human form and the demon form they took on after their death.
She apparently did not have children, as she told her husband they could have had a family.
She is first client of I.M.P shown in Helluva Boss, not counting those from the pilot, which is not canon.
Despite Faustisse stating that sinners have different voices when they were still human,[note 1] this does not seem to be the case for Mrs. Mayberry. Because of this, it is possible that this information has been retconned, and is not canon.
It is also stated that after sinners descend to Hell, they change their names.[1] It is unknown if Mrs. Mayberry did this since she was never addressed as anything other than "the newest client".
According to Vivziepop, Mrs. Mayberry may return in a future season, explaining that she wanted a lot of characters to return in the final season but mentioned that there was an opportunity to bring her back in season two.[2]
Mrs. Mayberry does reappear in season two, during the episode "Apology Tour" where she is seen living with Martha. It is implied that they are in a relationship, based on Martha's comments after Blitzo gave her a knowing look. Them being in a relationship and/or attracted to each other was also suggested by their appearance as a 2025 Valentine's Day "Couple Keychain".[3]

Paimon is a very tall avian demon resembling a great horned owl or raven, with black feathers over his body and larger feathers pointing upwards to resemble horns.

He has glowing red eyes with white pupils, and a white face reminiscent of an eye mask that bears intricate red sigils. He wears a long crimson cloak with a pale maroon upper section and gold trimming that covers his body, along with a hood that goes to about his chin.

When opened, the cloak is shown to be glistening like actual gold, similar to Stolas's cape in "Ozzie's". On his head is a golden crown decorated with a golden Goetic symbol and star ornaments on the points on top.

Underneath the cloak, he wears a red undershirt, maroon vest, white jabot, and dark gray pants.
Personality

Paimon has been shown to be a negligent father, who cannot recall his son's name without the help of his butler. He is a self-absorbed, inconsiderate and callous individual. When he made a child Stolas caretaker of the grimoire, he half-heartedly followed up by informing his son about the latter's arranged marriage to Stella, failing to consider, or care, about his son's opinion on the matter.

His disinterest in attending to his son's care is further emphasized when he dismisses his son's distress as "bitch crying", before forcing his son to attend a circus event with the expectation that it would calm him down. Even in this regard, he failed to actually physically accompany his son, opting to have his butler carry a magical mirror that allowed him to observe the event remotely. He would later go on to congratulate himself for being "so good at daddying” in regards to his treatment of Stolas.

Paimon upholds his status from being part of the Ars Goetia, looking down on those who are beneath his station. As seen when he slaps Stolas on the head and scolds the latter for bowing down to an imp when introducing himself, and his lack of consideration for the damage his rampant teleporting would cause the tent's for a circus.

Despite his poor parenting skills, Paimon has been shown to be a keen observer. He was able to quickly identify that his son was seemingly fond of a certain child circus performer imp, and took measures to have the aforementioned imp accompany his son to cheer him up. Though, the measures he took to hire the imp, offering to buy him for $5 and a slim-fit condom, further emphasize his deprecation of lower caste demons.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Immortality - As demonic royalty and father to Stolas, who is mentioned to be immortal, Paimon is biologically immortal, presumably being able to live for a long period of time and only able to be killed by angelic weaponry.
Shapeshifting - When he is first introduced, Paimon is seen transforming into several silhouettes of demonic creatures that include a goat, a four-headed snake, an elephant, and a winged eyeball (resembling the biblical Ophanim) before getting up from his throne.
Teleportation - Paimon was able to teleport his mirror self and Mister Butler away from Cash Buckzo's circus while leaving a flaming crater behind.
Grimoire manipulation - Paimon showcases the ability to summon forth the grimoire he later gifts Stolas.
Projection - Paimon is seen casting lifelike projections while imparting cosmic knowledge onto Stolas.
History

Past

ADVERTISEMENT

Gallery

Paimon/Gallery
Trivia

Paimon was first revealed in a tweet by the official Helluva Boss Twitter account as a celebratory sneak peek for season two on Father's Day.[1]
He is based on the demon of the same name from The Lesser Key of Solomon and is usually depicted as a man with an effeminate face, wearing a crown, and riding a dromedary. He teaches all arts, philosophies, and sciences, and all things secret, and is also quite obedient and loyal to Lucifer. Whether this version of Paimon in the series shares the same properties is still unknown.
The seal of Paimon was once on the outer wall of his mansion before handing over the ownership of it to Stolas.
He was the one who arranged for Stolas and Stella to be married the moment his son came of age.
Although unintentional, Paimon was responsible for Stolas meeting Blitzo, as they met when he brought Stolas to a circus performance to calm his crying.
It is revealed in "The Circus" that he has numerous other children apart from Stolas, which makes him forget their names, or at the very least, Stolas'.
After being reminded of Stolas' name by Mister Butler, Paimon refers to the former as "The owl boy", insinuating that his other children are of other bird-like breeds or different animals entirely.
He and Cash Buckzo share the same voice actor, with both being voiced by Jonathan Freeman.

"Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, implings! It's me, the Robotic Fizzarolli! Shipped from Big Ozzie's factory to bring you a wonderful show celebrating Loo Loo Land, spelled with O's, to avoid lawsuits!"
―Robo Fizz, introducing himself to his audience
The Robotic Fizzarolli, also known as Robo Fizz,[2] is a robotic double of the popular jester Fizzarolli made in Asmodeus' factory. Several models of the animatronic exist in a wide variety of colors and for various purposes. As of "The Full Moon", they are in a blowout sale as Mammon doesn't want them anymore since Fizzarolli quit.

The model that performed regularly at Loo Loo Land with his band, FizzaRolli 'n Friends, is a supporting antagonist who made his debut in the Helluva Boss episode "Loo Loo Land".

Appearance

Being based on Fizzarolli, all Robo Fizzes have an appearance similar to him but with key differences, such as pupilless eyes and the lack of a demonic tail. Most models lack feet, instead standing on the tips of their legs.

They each have white heads with a black spot at both ends of their mouths. Their arms and legs are retractable, able to extend and bend far more than normal jointed limbs could. On posters and ads, it is shown that they have a forked tongue, striped teal and black. Their head has an jester cap with bells.

Their interior is dark with a spine like their limbs, and two light grey cylinders at the top and bottom of the torso. Their arms connect to the torso with a spherical joint. From the head is two ear-like appendages with a single light grey joint in each.
Standard model

Their jester caps have blue and black on the left, and white and black on the right. They have a red and green top and dark blue pants with white lines. Their bodies have a black collar with bells below, as well as ruffle cuffs, and happy and sad faces on the shoulders.

Loo Loo Land model

His jester cap had green and pink stripes underneath on both sides, while on top is shades of blue with black stripes. He had a bright red and green top with lime trim at the bottom along with white hearts, as well as a lime ruffle with a black collar, and blue pants with light blue lines.

His eyes were lime, but when set on fire and his exterior melted he had a set of glowing red eyes with visible white pupils. Since having his exterior burned away he remains only as his internal endoskeleton.

Kitty

Kitty has glowing light blue arms and mouth with four sharp bottom teeth. It has a white torso, red eyes, and prominent eyelashes. It's jester hat is red with a darker shade underneath, white lines on top, and glowing light blue balls at the ends. In addition, unlike other Robo Fizz models, Kitty has a more feminine appearance.

Kitty wears a red outfit with a white below-the-shoulder collar with black outlining, a cedar ribbon on its waist, and fingerless gloves. It also wears long black heeled boots, as well as asymmetric tights; the left one is red with black stripes and the right is pink with red stripes.

Personality

Loo Loo Land model

While he's a robot and his status as alive is debatable, he's a sentient individual capable of rational thought and speech.

He seems to be content with his job as a child entertainer and a showman in Loo Loo Land. However, he can be extremely disdainful and belligerent, as he mocked Blitzo for his failed attempts at showbiz and had no qualms about getting in a fight that ended with Loo Loo Land burned to the ground.

He speaks with a stutter, often sparking, indicating that he is in a state of disrepair, or is of shoddy craftsmanship.

Abilities

Superhuman malleability - Robo Fizz's extendable robotic arms and a flexible body allow him to bend, stretch, and contract in many directions.
Superhuman durability - Being a robot, Robo Fizz can endure a high degree of damage. His teeth are strong enough to catch a bullet fired at him without a scratch.
Fire resistance - Robo Fizz’s endoskeleton has resistance against fire, in which he can move unhindered even when being engulfed in a sea of flames.
Speed-rolling - The Robo Fizz at Loo Loo Land was shown to be able to roll at rapid speeds and ram into his targets.
Skillset

Musical talent - The Robo Fizz at Loo Loo Land regularly performed as the lead singer of his attraction, despite his dilapidated and stuttering condition, he was able to sing clearly in the song number.
Gallery

Robo Fizz/Gallery
Trivia

Robo Fizz, alongside Fizzarolli himself, were revealed during the BLM Charity Stream.[2]
In "Murder Family", a drawing of Robo Fizz is pinned to the I.M.P office wall by a crossbow bolt.
Robo Fizz makes a small cameo earlier in the episode "Loo Loo Land" on a box of cereal called "Greed Seeds" that Octavia is eating for breakfast.
Robo Fizz's are advertised for sexual services, likely leading to Blitzo's nickname for him.
In one poster at Loo Loo Land it says that he "gives and receives", is "ribbed for your pleasure", has a "BDSM feature", as well as having "real tentacle action" and "ten speed vibration", but is also "machine washable".
There are advertisements for Robo Fizz on billboards, as seen in "The Harvest Moon Festival".
According to Fizzaroli in "Ozzie's", the Loo Loo Land Robo Fizz made more money entertaining children than other models have made for other services.
As revealed in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)", the Robo Fizzes are dishwasher safe, costs 69.99 Souls, and are non-refundable.
It is also revealed that there is a dildo juggling update for a monthly $89.98 subscription.
As the Robo Fizzes are modeled after Fizzarolli, it is mentioned by Mammon in "MAMMON'S MAGNIFICENT MUSICAL MID-SEASON SPECIAL (ft Fizzarolli)" that they have received adjustments in the past and would be adjusted more if Fizzarolli gains or loses weight, implying that they are made to be close to or exact to the body of the actual Fizzarolli.
The Fizzi Buddy
A Fizzi Buddy
There is a children's toy version of Robo Fizz called "Fizzi Buddy".
In a poster at Loo Loo Land, the toy is advertised to feature over 100 phrases and is only 48% asbestos.
Robo Fizz was the first character to pronounce Blitzo's name with the 'o' at the end.
During his performance of the Loo Loo Land song, he repeats the line "I have a dream" from Charlie's song, "Inside of Every Demon is a Rainbow", from Hazbin Hotel.
In the carnival show, Robo Fizz mentioned that he was shipped to the amusement park from Asmodeus's factory.[3]
As shown in "Radio Killed the Video Star", Valentino owns a Robo Fizz that he calls "Kitty". While Kitty has a more feminine appearance than other Robo Fizzes, as Robo Fizzes are modeled after a male it is unknown if Kitty was designed to be feminine-presenting male or as a female, or what it's gender is.
As shown in "The Full Moon", Mammon is holding a blowout sale for the Robo Fizz's as he doesn't want them anymore. A "blowout sale" is a sale with the intent to clear out old inventory, generally in order to make room for new products, and often accompanied by massive discounts.

He, along with his children, were killed when a missile projectile was launched at his home.

Ralphie is a muscular man with light brown hair with a white strand on the side of his head. His eyes appear to be closed most of the time. He also has a golden tooth on the bottom right canine.

He wears a plaid red shirt with blue jeans and brown boots. He also has a black and gray neck tie and wears a brown belt with a silver buckle.
Personality

Just like his family, Ralphie is a happy man to the public, but he is actually a homicidal maniac who worships Satan. Despite this, he cares very deeply for his family.

He is shown to be resourceful, as he used an empty bottle to strike Millie across the face when she got too close for him to properly use his shotgun.
History

Past

At an unknown time, Martha and Ralphie became a couple and had two children.

He is first seen with his children at Martha's bedside where she was hospitalized after Mrs. Mayberry attempted to kill her. He and Martha then go on to buy a house together.

Helluva Boss Season 1

"Murder Family"

When Blitzo prepares to shoot and kill Martha, Moxxie panics over killing a possibly innocent family and makes Blitzo's shot miss. Ralpie and his family pull out guns and begin hunting the imps, claiming to be for tomorrow nights dinner.

At the docks, Ralpie encounters Millie who attempts to attack him, but he hits her away with a bottle and she goes unconscious.

He takes her and ties her up at a ritual site with Blitzo where Martha attempts to send the pair back to Hell with fire. After the ritual fails due to imps being unharmed by earthly fire, Moxxie kills Martha which frightens Ralphie into rushing back to the house.

Once reunited with his children, they are held at gunpoint by Moxxie; however, Moxxie chooses to spare them and calls the police to give the family a chance at a better life. The local authorities arrive, but instead of apprehending the family a police helicopter fires a missile at the house, exploding the house with the family still inside.

Trivia

It is unknown if he was aware that his wife was cheating on him or if he and Martha had a plan consisting of her attracting men in order to lure in more victims.
After Martha's death, it was shown during the episode "Apology Tour" that she fell into Hell and became a Sinner, and confirmed with a piece of merchandise that Martha is now in a new relationship.[1] However, it is unknown if Ralphie or his children were condemned to Hell and became demons like Martha.

Rolando was an infestor demon and manager of the One Star Wonder hotel in Helluva Boss. He is a minor antagonist who made his debut in the episode "Ghostf**kers".


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Rolando's true form, an infestor demon, had the appearance of a tall, spindly, fish-themed demon who closely resembled an eel, with grayish-turquoise skin, silver-ish light green fins, yellow eyes with no irises or pupils, and a mouth full of sharp teeth.

His attire was a uniform that consists of a dark gray-purple waistcoat over a black-green collared shirt, dark gray fingerless gloves, black dress pants that have a gray-purple gradient, and black dress shoes. He also wore pointed, yellow-framed visors with lenses that have an orange tint.
Human disguise

In his human disguise, Rolando retains his body shape and takes the form of a pale-skinned man with a unibrow, a small mustache, and dirty-blonde hair that is styled in a comb-over with a cut in the back and a tuft sticking out.

His outfit remains the same, albeit its shades lean to that of a hotel employee, with a red waistcoat and a grey shirt alongside black pants. In addition, his visors change to a pair of thin-framed glasses with yellow-green-tinted lenses.

Personality

At first, Rolando was seemingly a harmless hotel manager who come across as grumpy and cynical. He dislikes Hollywood actors, seeing them as "pushy pricks" and a nuisance, even to his hotel, however, he was willing to let Blitzo disguised Bethany Ghostfucker "film an episode" and hunt the alleged ghost that kept killing his guests. In addition, he seems unbothered over being insulted, like when he didn't mind Blitzo calling him an idiot.

As an infestor demon, his true nature is that of a sadistic and psychopathic serial killer who killed his hotel guests. He even appears to have a love for physiologically and psychologically torturing humans and even other demons, such as Blitzo, by possessing them and forcing them to watch their worst or traumatic memories. This was shown when he was laughing and enjoying himself while Blitzo was terrified being shown with his past memories. However, Rolando's arrogance soon leads to his death, as he fails to account for Millie's strong friendship with Blitzo and later Blitzo remembering to kick the ghost-sucker into the pool.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Mental manipulation - Rolando has the power to see into his victims' minds to understand what they think and do. He can also manipulate his victim's mental cognition by creating lifelike hallucinations. By possessing someone, he can trap his victim inside their own mind, altering the mental landscape to what he chooses and showing them their most traumatic memories. The full extent of his psionic power poorly defined, given he could not only generate hallucinations, but also send mental shockwaves with a force that could make lightbulbs and granite columns crack.
Negativity absorption - According to Rolando himself, he is capable of feeding off of negative emotions, such as insecurity, as he says that Blitzo's insecurity was "intoxicating" and he "couldn't wait to see how he tastes once he drives Millie away" while being possessed by him.
Láspikinesis - He is capable of turning into a black goo-like substance, which he can use to move at great speed on land and when entering a victims mind. When he releases his hold on a victim, he exits out of their body in this form before reforming.
Possession - Rolando is able to possess others and take control of their bodies, and able to talk through them. This ability is not perfect, as the victim can still sense someone they have a strong attachment to even while suppressed. However, it is unknown if this will break the control Rolando has over them, given Rolando's reaction to Blitzo regaining awareness was only brief annoyance. Another weakness is that Rolando will still feel the injuries of those he possesses, as he is forced to leave Blitzo's body after Millie beats him down.
Human disguise - Similar to other Hellborn demons who have demonstrated this ability, Rolando has the ability to adopt a human disguise.
Superhuman strength - He could fight Blitzo and Millie with nothing but brute strength, tossing them around with ease.
Swimming - His aquatic demon form grants him the ability to move through water easily and rapidly, to the point that even Millie couldn't react fast enough.
Skillset

Hand-to-hand combat - Rolando was a skilled combatant, able to take on skilled assassins like Blitzo and Millie in a two-on-one fight and emerge nearly victorious.
Underwater combat - Rolando was an even deadlier combatant underwater, effortlessly trouncing Blitzo and Millie in the aforementioned two-on-one fight, and would have won had he not stopped to taunt them outside of water.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Past

At an unknown point of time, Rolando came to be the hotel manager of the One Star Wonder. He would mess with humans' minds at the hotel and kill those who found him out.

Helluva Boss Season 2

"Ghostf**kers"

He was the first person Blitzo and Millie met at the One Star Wonder hotel, recognizing Blitzo as Bethany Ghostfucker, explaining the disturbances at his hotel and handing him all the keys.

Later, he uses mind tricks on Blitzo, seemingly coating the vent he was in with ooze and then tilting it upwards causing him to slip. He then created illusions depicting what-if dead Millies (four of which representing a scenario where Millie could have died), as well as his mother who burns away in front of him. When Millie and Blitzo conclude that their target was actually an infestor demon and not a ghost, Rolando chases and throws them to the hotel pool room, shedding his human disguise and revealing his demon form. After a scuffle, Rolando enters Blitzo's mind, chaining him in a movie theater and forcing him to re-watch the trauma of his past.

Meanwhile, he possesses Blitzo's unconscious body and uses it to fight Millie while also using her earlier words against her, namely saying she's only good for killing and shouldn't have left Wrath. However, Millie fights back unfazed, knowing full well that Blitzo is not in control and gaining the upper hand, eventually forcing Rolando to leave Blitzo's body. In response, Blitzo knocks Rolando into the pool and subsequently tosses his "ghost sucker" device into the water as well, electrocuting the infestor demon to death.
